source: Project Amber (gi.yatta.moe) + the Genshin Impact Wiki (Fandom, CC BY-SA): Birthday Mails.

10000002.title: Frostflake Heron
10000002.about: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.
10000002.line: Come with me! We're not going far away — I promise it won't delay you too much. I managed to find out when your birthday was well in advance, so I could prepare in good time. Hopefully this wasn't assuming too much, but I guessed you might prefer this to an expensive gift. In honor of your birthday, please allow me to perform a fan dance for you.

10000003.title: Dandelion Knight
10000003.about: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.
10000003.line: Today is a day worth celebrating. If you must ask why, well, let me remind you that today is when you, the one who is blessed by the wind, came into the world. Since this is your birthday, I'll allow you to take it easy. Ahem... ♪Happy birthday to you...♪ Uh... Please forgive my presumptuousness. I hope this gift is to your liking.

10000006.title: Witch of Purple Rose
10000006.about: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.
10000006.line: Here, take this amulet, it will bring you good luck. It's my birthday gift to you. I spent a long time making it, so don't lose it now!

10000014.title: Shining Idol
10000014.about: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.
10000014.line: Here you go! This is the gift I got for your birthday, along with my exclusive autograph! Hehe, when my next song comes out, I'll make sure you're the first one to hear it! Happy birthday!

10000015.title: Frostwind Swordsman
10000015.about: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.
10000015.line: Today is a day worth celebrating, I hope this day can bring you true happiness.

10000016.title: Dark Side of Dawn
10000016.about: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.
10000016.line: Happy birthday. This is an important day for you. So tell me, what is it you wish for? If it is within my power to bestow it upon you, I will give it my consideration.

10000020.title: Wolf Boy
10000020.about: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.
10000020.line: Today is your day. You were born on this day, many moons ago. I want to make you happy today. Can we eat meat together?

10000021.title: Gliding Champion
10000021.about: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.
10000021.line: Hey, happy birthday! Here, I have a gift for you: an exclusive, custom-made version of Baron Bunny that I sewed for you myself. Uh... don't worry, "custom-made" means that it won't explode!

10000022.title: Windborne Bard
10000022.about: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.
10000022.line: Someone once told me you're supposed to eat a cake on your birthday... Tada! Here's your birthday cake — it's apple-flavored! And here's a spoon. The cake didn't rise properly in the oven... That's why it looks more akin to an apple pie... Ugh, baking is really quite complicated!

10000023.title: Exquisite Delicacy
10000023.about: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.
10000023.line: Ah, there you are! Come with me, I've prepared a birthday feast all for you! ... No really, I insist! Which dish is your favorite? It's okay, take your time, try them all first, then let me know!

10000024.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
10000024.about: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.
10000024.line: Come, board my ship. I've gathered the crew. The food and drink are all prepared. Today is your birthday, so you are the captain. Haha, so: where should we set sail?

10000025.title: Juvenile Galant
10000025.about: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.
10000025.line: May this day of your birth be filled with much mirth!

10000026.title: Vigilant Yaksha
10000026.about: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."
10000026.line: This mortal concept of commemorating the day of your birth really is redundant. Ahem. Wait. Uhh, have this. It's a butterfly I made from leaves. Okay. Take it. It's an adepti amulet — it staves off evil.

10000027.title: Eclipsing Star
10000027.about: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.
10000027.line: These are some of Liyue's finest brocades, woven from Silk Flowers. This one is for you, and this one... I hope that someday soon, you will be able to give it to your sister, and I hope that she'll like it. I wish you both a happy birthday./This is one of Liyue's finest brocades, woven from Silk Flowers. You can use it to have some clothing made, and have a happy birthday.

10000029.title: Fleeing Sunlight
10000029.about: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.
10000029.line: ♪Happy birthday to you, happy birthday to you, happy birthday dear Traveler, happy birthday to you!♪ You're older than me right? That means you've had way more birthdays than me... I'm sooo jealous!

10000030.title: Vago Mundo
10000030.about: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.
10000030.line: Happy birthday. This is a dried Glaze Lily that came into bloom on the day of your birth. Long ago, the people of Liyue would say that this flower blooms bearing the weight of the beautiful memories and prayers of the land. I believe this to have applied on the day you were born as well.

10000031.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
10000031.about: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.
10000031.line: Fischl: Well! If today is truly the anniversary of your birth, it shan't do for me not to mark the occasion. You have my full attention. Speak! Speak to me of your wishes, that which you most desire to fulfill during your fleeting and harsh existence in this wretched world. Whatever that wish may be. Even if, perchance— Oz: She means, "Happy Birthday, and if you want, she can—" Fischl: Silence, Oz.

10000032.title: Trial by Fire
10000032.about: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.
10000032.line: Happy birthday! Best of luck in the year ahead. Don't worry, bad luck isn't contagious! As long as I'm around, it'll be drawn to me and not you, so you're safe.

10000033.title: Childe
10000033.about: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.
10000033.line: Happy birthday, comrade! Anyone you need knocked off their perch today? Let me know. I'll happily oblige...

10000034.title: Chivalric Blossom
10000034.about: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.
10000034.line: Since you're always so busy adventuring, there must be so many little things you never get round to, surely? Well, you need not worry about them adding up, because today, I am all yours — your exclusive maid for the entire day! Just leave it all to me! ...Also, I'd like to take this opportunity to wish you a very happy birthday!

10000035.title: Icy Resurrection
10000035.about: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.
10000035.line: Many happy returns. Here is a bag of herbal medicine for you. You must be very surprised that I remembered? Let me explain. Last time you told me, I wrote your birthday down on a piece of paper. If I look at something once a day, it eventually goes into my long-term memory, and it will stay there forever.

10000036.title: Frozen Ardor
10000036.about: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.
10000036.line: On the anniversary of your birth, please accept this gift of a flower, made of ice crystals. I carved it myself. If you ever encounter an evil spirit, cast this toward it — the spell I have cast upon it will immediately come into effect and hopefully get you out alive. Also... Happy birthday.

10000037.title: Plenilune Gaze
10000037.about: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.
10000037.line: Many happy returns! After all the times you've looked out for me, I didn't even remember to get you a gift — whoops! Silly me, I... What's that behind my back? Ah. You saw it then. It's a failed attempt at making a Qingxin flower cake... I wanted it to be perfect, but... Oh, you think it tastes good? Do you really?

10000038.title: Kreideprinz
10000038.about: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.
10000038.line: Happy birthday. You look especially happy, would you mind if I sketched you? The capacity of our brains is limited, so we are bound to forget things. But when an image is transferred onto paper or canvas, the sketch becomes an extension of our memory. We can remember that past feeling when we later look at the sketch.

10000039.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
10000039.about: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.
10000039.line: Here you go — fried fish with my special sauce! ...Relax, I didn't add anything strange! My cooking is actually really good when I want it to be — stop talking and try it already! Hmph... that's better... Oh, and uh, happy birthday.

10000041.title: Astral Reflection
10000041.about: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.
10000041.line: Happy Birthday. Here's my gift to you — it's a bag containing some words of advice that may help you through tough patches. ...No, don't open it yet. During the year ahead, this bag will open itself when the right time comes.

10000042.title: Driving Thunder
10000042.about: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.
10000042.line: Happy birthday! I've got a very special gift for you. It might look like an ordinary old lantern, but this one runs on Electro energy and stays alight for a really long time. For those times when you need a little extra light in your life.

10000043.title: Harmless Sweetie
10000043.about: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.
10000043.line: Happy birthday! I've been running experiments for months, and finally I can give you this potion. It will allow you to relive your most beautiful memories of the past year. I call it "Bio-Potion No. 3916." Huh? No, no, not 3196, it's 3916!

10000044.title: Blazing Riff
10000044.about: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.
10000044.line: Happy birthday! I made some embroidery especially for you. Check it out — I sewed both our images on in the style of Fontaine's dolls. Pretty cute, eh? ...Why are you looking at me like that? Wh—What, it's not that weird that I can do embroidery!

10000045.title: Thorny Benevolence
10000045.about: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.
10000045.line: Today's your birthday, so if you have any dirty work that needs taking care of, I can give you a hand... Just don't tell anybody, got it?

10000046.title: Fragrance in Thaw
10000046.about: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.
10000046.line: Tonight the stars are dazzling and the moon majestic, it must be a special day... But just what day could it be... Haha, I know, I know! It's your birthday! It really is a great day.

10000047.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
10000047.about: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.
10000047.line: I heard it was your birthday, so I wrote a haiku for you. Unfortunately, I'm not the most talented in this area, and after trying for several evenings, I was still only able to come up with the first two lines... I guess I'll just share what I've got so far, then. "Sun and moon rejoice / Birds of dawn sing songs anew"... Wait, don't say a word, I think the final line is coming to me... Yes, how about... "Far from home, with you." Anyway, Happy Birthday. Let's go and get you some cake, shall we?

10000048.title: Wise Innocence
10000048.about: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.
10000048.line: Happy birthday! Here, this is for you. I've collated legislation from all the nations — you're planning to go traveling, right? It will serve you well to familiarize yourself with the law of the different lands. Don't study too hard mind you, or else... I won't be of any use to you.

10000049.title: Frolicking Flames
10000049.about: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.
10000049.line: Birthdays are never occasions for yourself alone. Those who send you cakes, light candles, applaud, and cheer... They are all truly thankful that you were born into this world. That's why it must be a lively occasion, so that everyone can get their chance to thank you! Well then — happy birthday! Are you ready? I'm about to ignite the fireworks!

10000050.title: Protector From Afar
10000050.about: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.
10000050.line: Quick, come with me! I remembered it's your birthday, obviously, so I thought I'd throw you a proper party. There's food, there's drinks, and I invited a whole bunch of your friends, too. Hey, this is your birthday we're talking about! I wasn't about to let you spend it all alone!

10000051.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
10000051.about: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.
10000051.line: Today is a day worth observing, though you shouldn't mark your development in age alone. Accept my gift of a bone whistle, and allow me to teach you its secrets. When your day of reckoning comes, see how long you can fend me off with it... It'll make the whole thing much more exciting.

10000052.title: Plane of Euthymia
10000052.about: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.
10000052.line: Happy birthday! Let's celebrate together and make it a moment to remember for the whole year until your next birthday celebration, and so on and so forth. Then, you shall have an eternity of happiness.

10000053.title: Mujina Ninja
10000053.about: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems to be lacking sleep.
10000053.line: Wanna learn some ninja skills? I can teach you! Well, only the skills I know, of course. Hmm? Why aren't I asleep? ...Uhh, because I'm not sleepy... and also because today is a special day! I had to stay awake today so I'd have the chance to say it to you in person: Happy Birthday.

10000054.title: Pearl of Wisdom
10000054.about: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.
10000054.line: Happy birthday! So, what are your plans for the day? Oh, why don't we celebrate on Watatsumi Island? First, I'll take you out at daybreak to see the sunrise, then we can go diving during the heat of the day. In the evening, we can go for a stroll around Sangonomiya Shrine. If it rains, we'll find somewhere cozy to hide out with a few strategy books, and try to bake a cake together! In any case, no need to plan anything, the grand strategist has everything thought out for you!

10000055.title: Canine Warrior
10000055.about: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.
10000055.line: Today's a momentous occasion, your birthday! Allow me to arrange all the celebrations for you! We can make a bonfire on the beach and catch some fresh fish and crabs. I'll personally prepare a morale-boosting meal that would make even the highest-ranking generals jealous.

10000056.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
10000056.about: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.
10000056.line: Excellent timing. I will dispense with the formalities and get straight to the point — do you have a birthday wish? Providing that it does not conflict with the Almighty Shogun's grand cause, I will make every effort to see it come to fruition. To show that I am being completely serious, I will allow you to make not one, but five birthday wishes.

10000057.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
10000057.about: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?
10000057.line: Today's an important day. I had to send the gang away, otherwise they'd be accusing me of favoritism. Here, take a look at this. I got you the greatest birthday gift combo ever! One top-grade Onikabuto — I'll have you know it took me three whole days and nights to catch this bad boy — one out-of-print collectible trading card that took me 300 rounds to get my hands on, and finally, a birthday song performance performed personally by yours truly! Happy Birthday to you, Happy Birthday to you, Happy Biiiirthday dear Traveler, Happy Birthday to youuuu!

10000058.title: Astute Amusement
10000058.about: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.
10000058.line: Ah, so today is your birthday... "On your ceremonious reckoning of years, I task my kin with seeing to it that that which you seek, you shall surely find, and that that for which your heart longs, you shall surely receive. Remain pure of heart and true of spirit, and their protection shall be bestowed on you." There you go. May all go well in your year ahead, and may all your wishes be fulfilled. Are we done?

10000059.title: Analytical Harmony
10000059.about: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.
10000059.line: After I learned that today was your birthday, there was a brief moment when I really wanted to take you to a locked room chock-full of mechanisms and gifts, where you could only get out by solving all the puzzles... Hehe, it's actually really fun! You know, of course I wouldn't do anything like that unless I was sure you'd actually enjoy it. Here, come with me. There's this beautiful scenic spot I've gotta show you before the sun goes down.

10000060.title: Valley Orchid
10000060.about: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.
10000060.line: If I was to tell you that maybe you shouldn't celebrate too hard today, because you'll let your guard down, and someone out there might just be waiting for that moment to make their move on you... it probably wouldn't go down very well. So, relax and take it easy today. Oh, and you should stop by the Yanshang Teahouse — I whipped up some treats especially for you. Not sweet ones, of course. Just the tiniest little hint of chili.

10000061.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
10000061.about: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.
10000061.line: Happy birthday! It doesn't matter if you're a human or a youkai, coming into this world is always worth celebrating! If you want, I can take you to the place I grew up in. It's not bustling with people, and it's not all that interesting, but it always makes me feel relaxed. Oh, and I'll let you sleep inside my favorite box, too! Having a nap inside it always feels great!

10000062.title: Savior From Another World
10000062.about: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.
10000062.line: Never put much stock in birthdays. Where I come from, it's a time to celebrate your mother, not yourself. Even so, I wish you a, uh... happy day.

10000063.title: Lonesome Transcendence
10000063.about: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.
10000063.line: I've been told that birthdays are important occasions for most people. They give presents to celebrate the anniversary of the other person's birth. Material possessions aren't really my thing, but... The view of the starry night sky in the mountains is the most beautiful thing I've ever seen in my life. I've frozen this lake and turned it into a mirror, so you can appreciate the reflection of the fleeting clouds and distant stars right up close. This is my way of celebrating your birthday... Hope you like it.

10000064.title: Stage Lucida
10000064.about: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.
10000064.line: Oh, so today's your birthday? Well, I wouldn't know how to throw you a feast if I tried... so how about I sing you a song? For you alone, an audience of one. So... what song would you like to hear me sing? The choice is yours.

10000065.title: Mender of Tribulations
10000065.about: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader - Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.
10000065.line: Happy birthday! Here, take this special dart made from Naku Weed. Be careful, yep, that's the way to hold it... Make sure you predict the trajectory before you throw it... Hehe, I'm happy that you like it. Oh, don't treat it like a toy, it's still quite dangerous. If you want to practice a little more, I can teach you.

10000066.title: Pillar of Fortitude
10000066.about: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.
10000066.line: Happy Birthday! Now, how would you like to be Yashiro Commissioner for a day, hmm? All the work has been handled already, so you can focus on simply enjoying the feeling of having an enormous amount of executive power at your fingertips. Don't worry, the retainers won't dare question it, I'll be with you the entire time, hehe.

10000067.title: Sprout of Rebirth
10000067.about: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.
10000067.line: Uh, H—Happy Birthday! Here's the cake I made for you, and here are the candles, so yeah... Amber said in her letter that this would do the job... Oh! And, and here's the gift I got for you! ...I'm sorry, I don't have much experience arranging birthday parties. I have no idea if you'll like it... Aah, I'm getting all flustered now. If anything's not how you like it, please say, and I'll make absolutely sure to plan a nicer birthday celebration for you next year!

10000068.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
10000068.about: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.
10000068.line: Today I can grant you one wish! After all, I am the great and almighty Dori! Go on, tell me, what do you wish for? But lemme just tell you now that a lifetime supply of Mora is off the table.

10000069.title: Verdant Strider
10000069.about: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.
10000069.line: Happy birthday! I picked out a potted plant in full bloom for you, along with a gardening guide. If anything happens to it, don't hesitate to find me at any time. This plant comes with a Forest Watcher lifetime guarantee. I'll have you know a lot of flowers are in season on your birthday. It took me forever to choose one. I'll get you a different species next year!

10000070.title: Dance of Lotuslight
10000070.about: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.
10000070.line: Umm... Happy birthday! I learned a new dance, and I want to show it to you. Uh, am I nervous? *sigh* You saw right through me. It's because... I wanted to incorporate my feelings into the moves, but then the choreography just got more and more difficult... Anyway, I just wish that your life will always be full of wonder and happiness.

10000071.title: Judicator of Secrets
10000071.about: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.
10000071.line: Ahem... I'd like to wish you a happy birthday. Though I don't have much experience with celebrations, once I realized your birthday was coming, I decided to make some preparations. First, I have this deck for you that I worked on for a few days, I think it'll really suit your style. Also, I adjusted my schedule to open up some time, so is there anywhere you'd like to go? I'd be happy to accompany you. A birthday only lasts a day, but you should take the chance to really enjoy it. Just make sure we can be back within three days.

10000072.title: Golden Vow
10000072.about: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.
10000072.line: Happy birthday! It's amazing to think that you were born on this day, years ago in the past. Do you have a birthday wish? If it involves going somewhere dangerous, let me join you — I'll be your guard. Or if you're looking to rest and revitalize, come to Aaru Village, and I'll serve you the finest meats and drinks we have.

10000073.title: Physic of Purity
10000073.about: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.
10000073.line: I was thinking, your birthday celebration needs to be at least as grand as the Sabzeruz Festival, so... Hmm? Too much? But everyone's already done preparing for it. C'mon, c'mon, let's go! Just this once — I'll make sure you love it!

10000074.title: Fantastical Evening Star
10000074.about: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.
10000074.line: Happy birthday. I got you this pocket astrolabe... The same stars witness the fate of the human race today as did yesterday, and as will forever. May they cast their gaze upon you, and may they stay with you always, through the desert and across the ocean, until you reach your destination.

10000075.title: Eons Adrift
10000075.about: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.
10000075.line: Give me your hand. Heh, there's no need to be nervous. I'm just taking you to a vantage point. How is it? The scenery here should be quite breathtaking. There's no need to thank me — I see little point in it.

10000076.title: Enigmatic Machinist
10000076.about: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.
10000076.line: Happy birthday! Here's a small toy for you. It's an assembly of a number of miniature puzzle mechanisms — you can find a button and lever here, as well as a roller to the side. Just play with it however you want, and I'll take care of it if it breaks. Hmph, and don't think I'm treating you like a child. Everyone, regardless of age, could use a moment of happiness and relaxation.

10000077.title: Burgeoning Grace
10000077.about: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."
10000077.line: This is the day of your birth, and as is tradition, this calls for a bowl of longevity noodles. I got Xiangling to teach me how to make it, and I managed to put all the noodles in the water without breaking a single one! I also put a big plump egg in there, hee-hee! Come on, let's go, you've got to eat it before it goes cold. Wishing you a happy, healthy birthday and a long and prosperous life.

10000078.title: Admonishing Instruction
10000078.about: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.
10000078.line: Happy birthday. I've always thought people are a little too enthusiastic about celebrating the day they were born. Wouldn't it be better to apply all that enthusiasm towards their daily lives and improve their standards of living? But you seem to have done well for yourself. I didn't know what kind of gift to get, so I'll just set up a special application channel, reserved for your submissions alone.

10000079.title: Flame-Mane
10000079.about: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.
10000079.line: Happy Birthday! Reach into your pocket, your present's already in there. How'd I do it? Hehe, just a little trick of the trade. Anyway, more importantly, I've booked us a real feast at Lambad's Tavern, so let's get ourselves over there! ...Huh? Oh, don't worry, I didn't invite any of the other mercs. Nah, that rowdy bunch is always getting into arguments — not the kind of people you'd want at a birthday celebration. It'll just be me and you, like it should be... Ahem, c'mon, c'mon, let's go.

10000080.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
10000080.about: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.
10000080.line: Oh, what should we do for an occasion like this? Hmm... Today is your most special day, so we should really live it up! I've prepared "A Tour of Mondstadt's Most Stunning Spots." It contains information on lots of beautiful locations that are hardly known to anyone else. I wish you happiness every day until this day arrives again next year.

10000081.title: Empyrean Reflection
10000081.about: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.
10000081.line: Is it your birthday today? Well, congratulations! Birthdays are important days, and it's also one of those days in the year that gets you thinking about your family. However you spend today, I hope it makes you happy.

10000082.title: Beyond Mortality
10000082.about: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.
10000082.line: Changsheng: Sss. Refresh my memory, Baizhu. How do we say that again...? Baizhu: Hehe. You mean how to wish someone a happy birthday? Changsheng: Yes, precisely! Baizhu: I hope that this day will be one filled with joy every year, and that you would always keep these times near. Happy Birthday, Traveler! Changsheng: Hey, so what should I say now? Let me think... Um, uh... *sigh* I can't think of anything. I sincerely wish you a happy birthday, too. Changsheng: What are you laughing at? People are so bothersome, with more traditions and twists than even a snake.

10000083.title: Elegance in the Shadows
10000083.about: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.
10000083.line: Happy Birthday! Let me give you this card... it's not a greeting card, so of course nothing's written on it. Write down what kind of present you want, place it in my hat, and no matter what it might be, you'll get it.

10000084.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
10000084.about: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.
10000084.line: I have a feather here, just an ordinary feather... Go ahead, you can hold it and see for yourself. Ready? And... boom! It was a party popper all along. Happy Birthday! See this? I caught one of the paper streamers floating down. Now, make a wish and picture a birthday gift in your mind's eye as I light it. Three... two... one... Great! Verrry good, I know exactly what you were thinking now. The last step, put your hand inside my hat... Well? Is it the gift you wanted?

10000085.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
10000085.about: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.
10000085.line: Would you be willing to come with me somewhere? There's this place I know where the scenery is spectacular. I think it's even more magical than a fantasy novel. I have a secret hideout there, and I keep some glowing sea creatures as pets... I just want to give you a birthday experience like you've never had before, and then give you my birthday wishes... Will you give me the chance to do that?

10000086.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
10000086.about: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.
10000086.line: Our tradition says that all children of Fontaine are born amid their parents' wishes and blessings, but I'd like to think that all children are born from such wonderful feelings. Anything that I can say to celebrate your birth would feel a little trivial next to that, right? Unfortunately, I won't be able to reduce your prison sentence if you were to commit a crime — the only thing I would be able to pull off would be a special Welfare Meal for your birthday dinner. With all that in mind, why don't you try to respect the law a bit more around your birthday, so we'll be able to celebrate somewhere nice on the surface?

10000087.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
10000087.about: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.
10000087.line: Ah, so it's your birthday. Happy birthday. I do not know if rain is in the forecast today, but let me see what I can do.

10000088.title: Lens of Verity
10000088.about: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."
10000088.line: Happy Birthday! Did you read today's Steambird yet? I put a birthday greeting in there for you, hehe... Wait, you still haven't bought a copy? No problem, I picked one up before leaving the office. Look — here it is! I fought pretty hard to get it on this page.

10000089.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
10000089.about: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.
10000089.line: Happy Birthday! Here, please take this ticket as your gift. It's a VIP seat to see Happy Day, just don't forget to show up to the performance! Hmm? What's "Happy Day"? *sigh* Well, I wanted to keep it a surprise... But it's an opera that I've rehearsed personally. It's about a big group of people that gather together to celebrate a certain very important person. You understand now, right? Just don't forget to come!

10000090.title: Executor of Justice
10000090.about: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.
10000090.line: Happy Birthday! Ahem... At attention! Chin up, shoulders back! Let's take your measurements... I want to commission a smaller, more portable musket and holster for you... Okay, at ease. While the musket is being commissioned, you need to log some hours at the shooting range first. No time like the present! Follow me!
dish: Sin: The Kind that Doesn't Need to be Dealt With

10000091.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
10000091.about: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.
10000091.line: Do you believe that wishes can come true? You know, like when you toss a coin into a fountain for good luck? As long as you throw enough coins in, one of your wishes is sure to come true, right? Well anyway, today's your birthday, so I'm not leaving anything to chance — I've got a whole bag of Mora here dedicated to making your birthday wish come true. Whatever you want, I'll do everything in my power to make it happen!

10000092.title: Leonine Vanguard
10000092.about: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.
10000092.affiliation: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency
10000092.line: So a little birdie told me that it's your birthday today... When were you planning on telling me? Tsk... Anyway, I went ahead and made a reservation at Xinyue Kiosk. Eight dishes, a soup, and as much rice as you can eat, with Longevity Buns and Tong Sui for dessert. Plus I invited all your friends along. Uh, and I also put together a little birthday wushou dance for you — nothing extravagant, just a bit of fun really — but yeah, I hope you like it!

10000093.title: Passerine Herald
10000093.about: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."
10000093.line: Here, open this wooden box. It's a miniature mechanical person for your recreational enjoyment. Try playing with it. Observe — if you clap the hands like this, the lotus petals open, the colored lights turn on one set at a time, and then a melody plays. It is that birthday tune that the young and hip of this generation enjoy so much. Certain to add a touch of merriment and levity to your birthday feast... Have a wonderful day.

10000094.title: The Thundering Seamstress
10000094.about: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.
10000094.line: Yeah, yeah... Happy birthday, or whatever. Just tell me if there's a gift you like — I can't be bothered to try and guess what you want. Hm? Too direct? Alright then, why don't you grab Navia, Kirara, and the others, and maybe a few of your friends as well. We can have a party tonight at my place. I'll take some notes on the gifts that the others have prepared for you, and make you an accessory right then and there. Ten thousand mora that you'd like it. Haha, call it the confidence of the owner of Chioriya Boutique.

10000095.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
10000095.about: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.
10000095.line: Happy Birthday! From what I've observed, you're always going from one place to the next. So, I made a special skincare set just for you that's portable and practical. Come on, lay down and close your eyes, I'll show you how to use it. First, I'm gonna apply a wet compress to your face — but you can just splash some water on there if you're ever in a hurry... Next, we squeeze out a small amount of foam cleanser, gently massaging it in with a circular motion, following the muscle, before rinsing and drying... And lastly, we apply some moisturizer with Tidalga extract... And, we're done! You look radiant, and now it's time for lovely little you to go and enjoy your special day to the fullest!

10000096.title: Dire Balemoon
10000096.about: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."
10000096.line: This memo states that today is your birthday. Is that true? Birthdays should be lively occasions. It's always nice to have an excuse to set formal matters aside every now and then, whether it's for the purpose of celebrating yourself or others. Come. I've prepared a feast for you at the House of the Hearth. Let's not keep the children waiting.

10000097.title: Wisdom's Measure
10000097.about: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.
10000097.line: You know, your hair would look amazing if it was done up in a desert-dweller style... How about kicking off the next year of your life with a new hairdo, huh? If you're up for it, just leave it to me. You'll look glamorous, I promise you.

10000098.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
10000098.about: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.
10000098.line: Happy Birthday. I have a gift for you — it's a short-sword necklace that I made myself. In the Marechaussee Hunters' tradition, on a new member's first birthday as a hunter, his/her mentor will make him/her a short-sword necklace with his/her name engraved, to be worn with the sword hanging over the chest. This is to symbolize interrogating his/her own heart at swordpoint: Will I tread the path of treachery, is there doubt in my heart, or am I resolved to eradicate all evil? Though you're not a Marechaussee Hunter, I believe that you're committed, like I am, to fighting the good fight. Why a sword, and not a musket? Because guns can misfire. Also, there's something a little inelegant about interrogating your heart at gunpoint.

10000099.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
10000099.about: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.
10000099.line: Happy birthday! I know perfume preferences are extremely personal, but I took the liberty of choosing one I think you'll like. It's one of my own creations, actually, but it's not available to purchase yet. I tried to combine the floral and fruity notes found in nature around this time of year. I was going for more of a subtle scent. Anyway, I hope it brings you a little peace and comfort whenever you wear it.

10000100.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
10000100.about: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.
10000100.line: Happy birthday! This is for you. It's a pika carved from Iridescent Opal. Iridescent Opal's quite warm to the touch, but it doesn't really stand out, so it's easy to miss it underground. The more you carry it with you, though, the shinier it gets! It's one of my favorite gems, so I hope you'll like it too.

10000101.title: Turnfire Hunt
10000101.about: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.
10000101.line: Kinich: Ajaw? Ajaw: Alright, alright. Tch, you love bossing people around almost as much as you enjoy taking people's money. Next time, get your own pair of wings and you do the flying... You, yes you. Don't just stand there, climb up onto my back already. A ride through the skies on the back of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw is a once-in-a-lifetime honor. Kinich: Don't worry, it's just a gentle cruise through the forest. Just follow me. I planned out a route in advance and I promise it's safe. Ajaw: Don't forget what you promised me in return! Kinich: Alright, now hop on... Happy birthday.

10000102.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
10000102.about: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.
10000102.line: Happy birthday! Don't open your gifts just yet. I picked this restaurant just for you, it's the most popular one around... I bet you've already gotten loads of well-wishes from your friends, but what if I told you even more people from your journey wanted to help you celebrate? What do you think? Hehe! C'mon, have a seat and let's bring on the birthday wishes! Ahem... Excuse me, everyone! Your attention, please! Today is my friend's birthday! A noble and formidable hero who's defeated ferocious beasts and healed countless souls! C'mon, let's give him/her our warmest birthday wishes! Alright, you guys over there, say it with me, "Here's to good fortune on your adventures!" Great! And you guys over there... "Here's to success in battle!" Perfect! Finally, all together, now... Happy birthday, Traveler! Here's to good luck, good health, and much happiness!

10000103.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
10000103.about: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.
10000103.line: Happy Birthday. Here, this universal multi-tool set is yours to keep. It has a variety of drills and hammers, as well as three hand saws and five special-shaped prybars, which should come in handy for you in the wild. Oh, and there is also a set of ropes made from woven leather and metal wire. They should be strong enough to lift even a fully-grown Tepetlisaur. Do you know how to tie knots? If not, I can teach now. Here, watch... First, hold the rope like this, then loop it around...

10000104.title: Skyborne Arbiter
10000104.about: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.
10000104.line: Here, take this gun. It's loaded with six rounds, including an extra-special one. Find an open space and try it out — or better yet, fly up into the sky and do it there. Ooh, you got the special round on the first try, huh? Luck's on your side today... That was a whistling birthday firework. I made it myself! Hmm? ...What are the other five rounds? More fireworks, of course! But they're the trial runs that I made before the one you just fired off. The color's different, and they're not perfect. Next year, I'll do my best to make a full six top-quality rounds for you.

10000105.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
10000105.about: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.
10000105.line: In Natlan, we believe a person's birthday decides their fate. Sharing a birthday with a great hero means being blessed with their protection and inheriting their character. I'm not sure the people out there who share your birthday know how lucky they are... Happy Birthday.

10000106.title: Night-Igniting Flame
10000106.about: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.
10000106.line: Starting from today, you should write down all your accomplishments on a piece of paper. Then, when you take it out on your next birthday, you'll have a gift from yourself! That way, you'll never forget how amazing you are. Happy Birthday, Traveler.

10000107.title: Obsidian Opalstar
10000107.about: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.
10000107.line: Happy birthday! Honestly, I don't know what to get you. There are no inauspicious stars in your path. Whether in regard to love, battle, or your future endeavors, your prospects seem great. A Mictlan-style blessing won't do much for you. I thought about getting you a copy of "Flowers for Princess Fischl" to get you hooked on light novels, but it seems like someone owns more books from Yae Publishing House than me... Ahh, what to do... what to do?

10000108.title: Spring Woven From Jade
10000108.about: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.
10000108.line: In my family, we always give silver accessories as birthday gifts. So, here, these two figures are for you. The one with the silver swallow on the head is me, and the one with the small silver sword is you/the one with the silver flower is you. Hehe, looks just like us, right? I infused the rattan strands with incense, so hanging them on your knapsack should repel insects. Oh, and I designed the silver accessories, too. The silversmith polished them once, and I made sure to smooth out the edges a second time, so you don't have to worry about cutting yourself. Well, happy birthday, Traveler! May luck always be on your side!

10000109.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
10000109.about: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.
10000109.line: Today is a very special day for the both of us. Meeting you has given me the chance to witness a wondrous world of endless dreams... So, why don't we celebrate this occasion with a dreamscape for just the two of us? Of course, we'll need to build it from the ground up. So, tell me what you'd like to see...

10000110.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
10000110.about: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.
10000110.line: Happy birthday! Would you like to try my custom-made fitness cake? There's no cream or sugar, so it's low-calorie, and I added in some veggies and grains to balance out the nutritional profile. Most birthday cakes out there are dangerous things to have around. All they do is make sure your body fat percentage goes up every year along with your age...

10000111.title: Strength in Serenity
10000111.about: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!
10000111.line: Heehee... Today's your birthday, I'm so excited! The tradition in our tribe is to get all your friends together and host a bonfire feast in your honor. The birthday person gets to cheers everyone and drink as much as they want! Although... with you being so famous, I guess you'd end up having to down at least a thousand drinks... Which would be great fun, I'm sure, but probably not the best thing for your liver. And it could get exhausting, too... Hmm, how about something more low-key instead? Like... a private party at my secret campsite?

10000112.title: Tasteful Excellence
10000112.about: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.
10000112.line: Esteemed Traveler, you are the "ultimate variable" of Teyvat, the one who brought a unique flavor to this world. A birthday celebration in your honor calls for a feast with eighty dishes at least — four meat, four wild game, four pastry, and two soup dishes, just to start... Still, gorging on food is no way to dine — it's a disservice to your health and to the dishes themselves... Thus, we shall just have to celebrate your birthday over the entire week! Ten dishes a day should do it. I want you to appreciate each one to the fullest. A culinary symphony awaits!

10000113.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
10000113.about: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.
10000113.line: Happy birthday! Wishing you good health and eternal youth. Sure, you can't stop the relentless march of time, but you can always stay young at heart — and besides, dude, a bad mood doesn't do your health any good. So come on, just for today, cast your worries aside and let's have some fun! Oh yeah, also, what kind of music are you into? I'll play a song.

10000114.title: Void Star
10000114.about: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.
10000114.line: Happy Birthday. I know some people like to throw a huge party, while others prefer a quieter affair. I don't know which kind of person you are, but for me, birthdays are a time to reflect on the past year — sometimes with pride in my progress, other times with profound regret. ...It's probably best not to ascribe so much meaning to birthdays after all. Each place has its own festivals for celebrating the land, one's ancestors, friendship... but your birthday is the one day of the year that is meant just for you. Okay, speech over — once again, I wish you a Happy Birthday, and I hope you keep growing into the person you aspire to become.

10000115.title: Ode and Oblation
10000115.about: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.
10000115.line: May this fertile land bless me with a bountiful harvest of grains, to brew into fine wine for my guest. May the returning wind bless me with blossoms, to rain down in celebration of this gathering here today. May our god bless this day of my dear friend's birth, and watch over him/her I pray... 'Kay, you wanna blow the candles out now?

10000116.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
10000116.about: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.
10000116.line: Congratulation mode for special days, activated. Please select a suitable location to sit and rest for a few moments, while I clean your room and put up ribbons, balloons, and flowers. Then, I will prepare your favorite meal and cake, as per the data recorded in my memory banks. If you have any other requests to add to this list, please do not hesitate to raise them. Let's make today a special one for you. Happy Birthday!

10000119.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
10000119.about: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.
10000119.line: To you, our honored guest, cherished by the moonlight and our tranquil forest, I give this blessed dagger. For a dagger does not have to be an object of violence — indeed, they are often used as symbolic items in prayer ceremonies. That said, you're of course free to use it for whatever purpose you wish.

10000120.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
10000120.about: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.
10000120.line: Those who love you will celebrate your arrival in this world by preparing a feast, singing songs, and offering blessings. When you pass away, those who miss you will grieve by holding a funeral and lighting lanterns. In life and in death, there will always be those who are moved by your existence. So, take the chance, while your soul is full of life, to come together with your loved ones and be happy — you deserve it. ...Uh, excuse me? You want me to... be your birthday candle?

10000121.title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
10000121.about: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.
10000121.line: Looks like someone's waiting for an Aino surprise... Tada! Hehe, it's the Spinny Chanty Wishing Lantern! When you light the candle, it sings happy birthday and spins around. Isn't it fun? If you like it, then you have to play with me next year too! Oh, uh, now you gotta make a wish, and you gotta say it out loud so I can hear it! Whatever you wish for, Aino the genius can make it come true!

10000122.title: Secret Beneath the Sands
10000122.about: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.
10000122.line: I'm not the best at picking gifts, so how about this: I'll pose three questions to you, and if you find the correct answers, I'll... Relax, that was meant to be a joke. Here, take this book. It's a collection of desert folklore and fairy tales — some of the most complete versions that exist. Generations of desert-dwellers have grown up hearing them, then passed them on themselves. Who knows? Once you've finished reading them, perhaps you'll be able to thrive in the desert too.

10000123.title: "The Undying Fire"
10000123.about: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.
10000123.line: It feels like your birthday's come around so fast! I'm sorry, I keep thinking of new details to add, so I still haven't finished... This is an origami boat I've been making for you — the paper animals on board are our friends. And this person standing at the bow, who I haven't had time to color in yet, is you. In my mind, you helm the ship, radiating golden light... Do you want to help me paint you gold? Oh, I almost forgot — this boat is called "The Traveler." May you continue to sail forward alongside your friends! Happy birthday!

10000124.title: Windthreading Shadow
10000124.about: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).
10000124.line: Happy birthday! Here ya go, this doll's for you! I just finished sewing it. It was my first time trying this technique — took ages, you know! I stuffed it with calming herbs that'll help you sleep, so just put it next to your pillow and I promise you'll sleep nice and soundly, 100% nightmare-free. The bandage on my hand...? Ah... just a little scratch from... playing with Ashru, hahaha... It's nothing, really...

10000125.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
10000125.about: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.
10000125.line: Your birthday is on the same day every year? Wow, that's easy to remember. Moon-Prayer Night is held at different times each year, so I can only estimate my birthday by sensing the moon. A birthday is such a joyous occasion, isn't it? Everyone gathers to dance while people make delicious offerings to give you. Huh...? Regular people's birthdays aren't like that? Gifts, cake, and friends...? Oh, that works too. Let's invite your friends to celebrate. I can sing you a song, and we can even ask Maalaus to paint a picture for you.

10000126.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
10000126.about: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.
10000126.line: Today is your birthday? Then we must celebrate. I recall that it is customary for the elderly to eat Longevity Noodles... Hehe, and while you appear youthful, I suspect that if we were to count the years since your birth, you would in fact be older than most people in Liyue Harbor. In that sense, preparing a bowl of Longevity Noodles for you would not be an inappropriate gesture... Hmm? Of course I know how to make them. I may have joined the celestial ranks in my time, but I wasn't born with a silver spoon in my mouth... *sigh* Frankly, the only reason I no longer have much of an appetite these days is probably all that time I spent in the heavens without any facility to cook... But I digress. Eating is the second most important affair in the world, so we must ensure that you enjoy a good bowl of Longevity Noodles before the day is through.

10000127.title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
10000127.about: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.
10000127.line: Happy birthday, squadmate! Forget about commissions and adventures — days like this are reserved for close friends, full bellies, and catching up on sleep! I'll be standing watch, so you just focus on letting your hair down. And on the off-chance we get gate-crashers, I'll scare 'em off with my trusty lamp.

10000128.title: Knight of Boreas
10000128.about: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.
10000128.line: Happy Birthday! Don't go anywhere, the Knights of Favonius are getting ready to give you a birthday chorus. To be clear, this isn't an abuse of authority. They're the ones who suggested it! I just helped organize things and set up the venue. You do know how much we all adore our Honorary Knight, don't you? Now come on, everyone's waiting for the birthday star and lead singer!

10000129.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
10000129.about: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.
10000129.line: Today's your birthday, so I got you a mini-crossbow. I came up with the design myself. It should be the perfect size for your wrist... When did I measure your wrist? Don't worry, I did it by eye. You can trust my ability to gauge things like this — I'm vice captain of the 5th Company, after all. Oh, right, this crossbow can also fire backward, just in case someone sneaks up on you. You just press... here. Hahaha, no need to duck! The safety lock is still on. Do I look like the kind of person who gives a friend a crossbow just to watch them shoot themselves...

10000130.title: Augur of Wonders
10000130.about: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.
10000130.line: Happy Birthday... This isn't the most valuable gift, but it's something I've had in my collection for a long time... Please accept this fossil. See this? These are bone and feather impressions from a long-extinct bird species. They'll never fly again, and yet the moment that this one spread its wings has left an imprint that will last long into the future. So, even if life fades in the end, there will always be some proof of our existence left behind. May your life be as tenacious as an old tree, with each and every ring telling a beautiful tale.

10000131.title: Clamor Within
10000131.line: Happy Birthday! I hid your birthday gift inside a chest and set up a bunch of puzzles for you to solve. Come on, I'll guide you through it!

10000132.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
10000132.about: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!
10000132.line: Happy Birthday! No need to look so surprised — not like it's hard to fish a date out of people. There is a crucial piece of information I didn't manage to uncover though... Your birthday wish! Huh? Saying it out loud means it won't come true? I disagree. That just makes it harder for people like me to help make it a reality. So, c'mon, no use beating around the bush. What do you want? You might think there's not much I can do, but I've saved up quite a bit of allowance. Besides, you're always saying how smart I am, so I'm sure it's something I can help with! Unless it's something like, "buying a house in the center of Mondstadt with no mortgage." But, you wouldn't wish for something that unreasonable... right?

10000133.title: Mirrored Analysis
10000133.about: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.
10000133.line: Hmph. Here, take this. I wouldn't normally give these out, but today's a special day — it marks the day you came into the world. I invited Arlecchino and Columbina, plus a few shared friends. I even baked a special cake for the occasion... so you'd best look forward to it.

10000140.title: Lingering Siren-Song
10000140.about: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin.
10000140.line: Happy Birthday! I've set aside your gift. You can open it later. It's just some small trinkets, toys, and whatnot... Eh, but that's not the important part. You're free now, aren't you? In that case, come with me! We're going to my echo chamber. I got someone to buy me a Dance-Off Stage from Natlan a few days ago, along with a whole bunch of weird and wonderful instruments. I'm working on the best music event Snezhnaya's ever seen, and guess who's the first person to receive an invitation? That's right, it's you! Come on, let's sing the night away!

10000143.title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
10000143.about: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.
10000143.line: Ding-dong! The moment has arrived! You have no idea how hard it was for me to hold it in yesterday... But I had to, because saying it early is bad luck — you might get swallowed up by a snowstorm! Now, I can finally say it: Happy Birthday, my dear friend. May you stand as strong as the birch tree, never defeated by the wind and snow. Alright, that part's done. Next, tradition dictates that I've got to give our birthday superstar a few gentle tugs on the ear...

10000148.title: Swift-Striding Hound
10000148.about: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.
10000148.line: Happy Birthday. It is today, isn't it? Y'know, where I come from, birthday celebrations are usually a luxury we can't afford. Good luck scrounging up enough flour and cream for a cake, or finding someone who sells anything but the bare essentials to use as a gift. But, I'll never begrudge a kid for wanting to celebrate their birthday. That's how it should be, and one day, I hope no child in Snezhnaya has to go without. So, I've decided to take your birthday very seriously, and I've put a lot of thought into the gift and card I got for you. Sometimes, you have to be the change you want to see in the world, right?

10000150.title: Swirling Snow
10000150.about: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.
10000150.line: Happy Birthday! I was trying to think of what to get you... I usually receive things like flowers, ballet shoes, and music boxes, but I doubt that's what you have in mind. How about you simply... make a wish, here and now? Ideally, something within my power to grant, of course...

Aino.title: Guess Where!
text: I'll count to three, and you have to guess where I am right now! Ready? Three, two, one... Got your answer? I'm gonna tell you on the very next line, so no peeking!
Ineffa and I are at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort!
Hee-hee, you didn't get it, did you?

Ineffa brought me here specially so we could celebrate my birthday together! This place is sooo big! The Asha are all soft and bouncy, and they feel just like jelly when you touch them! The buildings are covered in all sorts of colors, like candy wrappers, and the drinks from the little roadside stalls are super sweet, too... There's so much fun stuff here, I don't even know where to start! Anyway, I love everything about this place!
After we eat our way around one more time, and then play our way around one more time, I'm gonna bring some paints back as presents for all the little robots at the Craftshop!
Next time, I'll bring you here for your birthday too!

Albedo.title: Lately...
text: Durin has made remarkable progress in alchemy lately.
Several subjects he has been researching on his own have even produced results beyond our expectations. As a result, we have actually found ourselves with more time to talk about everyday life.

Durin has a keen interest in all sorts of things, from observing society and appreciating literature to exploring different foods... He is always eager to share what he has discovered with me, and just as eager to hear my response.
Our personalities are quite different. Still, I think I once knew times like these myself, so I understand how much they mean to him.

When he learned that you were traveling in a snowy land, he made a point of asking me for a stew recipe. He said that, if the opportunity arises, he would like to make it for you himself, to help ward off the cold and keep you warm.
To me, his kindness and sincerity are what make him most precious. In that respect, he is quite like you.
I am writing to you in my capacity as your registration agent to remind you that exam week is approaching.
As the two of you are still on the road, and Vahumana exams are typically open-book, the instructors have agreed that this round of exams may be conducted via correspondence.
I'm enclosing here the exam topics, along with the materials Paimon's Vahumana advisor would like her to read in their entirety.

P.S. I've also taken the liberty to submit an application for the Driyosh eligibility review on Paimon's behalf, and she has cleared for the interview stage. The interview, which will take place in three stages, will begin three days after exam week. You may accompany her if you wish, as the Akademiya will also provide lodging and meals for accompanying family members.

Aloy.title: A Familiar Place...
text: Haha, Nod-Krai's a strange place. But I'll admit, it's interesting.
They've got this amazing thing called "kuuvahki" that powers all kinds of machines...

I even met a robot girl. Pretty cute actually. Saw her climb three stories with her bare hands just to help some kids get a balloon down... Behind her workshop, there's a huge duck-shaped machine just sitting there.

Oh, and the workshop's owner, Aino? She's a genius. We ended up talking for ages — circuit layouts, mechanical structures... one idea after another. If the robot girl hadn't reminded us, we probably would've forgotten to eat.
Anyway. Knowledge like that is too good to keep to myself. Here, I copied my notes for you.
Trust me, they're worth a look.

Amber.title: See You Up There!
text: I've discovered a secret that can only be seen from the sky!

A few days ago, I was gliding over Millhaven on patrol and looking down at the flower fields. Then, just as I was about to land, I caught the view from a certain angle with the sunlight shining just right... and the flower field had actually formed the shape of a rabbit! The ears, the tail... all perfectly clear!

Was that a coincidence? Or some gardener's latest masterpiece? Or could it be... a birthday surprise for me from Baron Bunny? Heh, whatever the truth is, I didn't want to keep a view this wonderful to myself — and you were the first person I thought of.
The spot isn't easy to find, and no words can do this view justice. Are you free today? I can take you to see it with your very own eyes.
It's settled then! I'll see you up in the sky!

Arataki Itto.title: Be a Proud and Upstanding Oni!
text: Good news, compadre! Takuya's getting out of prison real soon!

To celebrate him turning over a new leaf and becoming a proper oni again, we're gonna make a real occasion out of this. First, the Arataki Gang boys will line up in front of the police station. Then Genta will give Takuya a good pat-down to drive away the bad luck, Akira will hand him the flowers, and Mamoru will whistle and clap to get everyone hyped up. As for Shinobu and Ushi... Ugh, those two are saying they want no part in this.
That's not a big deal though, since the main event is all on yours truly. When the moment comes, I'm gonna deliver a power performance of "From This Day Forward, Be a Proud and Upstanding Oni"!
And you, my bestest compadre, shall sing along with me!
I've saved the most awesome verse just for you... and for Lavender Melon too. Sure, her pipes aren't quite on my level, but I've got her lines all ready anyhow.
Needless to say, Takuya's definitely gonna be moved to tears and beg to join the Arataki Gang... BWAHAHAHA!
There's no time like the present, partner — so whaddya say we practice our singing together today?

Arlecchino.title: Feel It for Yourself...
text: You must have heard many people describe Snezhnaya in all sorts of ways by now.

But no matter how many times you hear others speak of the biting cold, it is nothing compared to scooping up a handful of snow yourself and feeling the change in temperature as it melts in your palms.

And once the snow has melted, whether you choose to keep it cradled in your hands, letting your body warmth drive away the stinging chill, or open your fingers and let it fall to the ground and refreeze... that choice is yours and yours alone.
Whatever you choose, you are now in Snezhnaya, imagine you have already formed your first impre of the place.

If you have some spare time, come by and have a chat with me, and sample some of Snezhnaya's local cuisine while you're at it. Lyney and Lynette are here as well, and they've put together a new magic performance. I think you'lll find a visit very much worth your while.

Baizhu.title: A Special "Prescription"...
text: Lately, a curious trend has taken hold in the streets, with people extolling the virtues of all sorts of "miracle tonics." Even those who have rarely set foot in Bubu Pharmacy have come to inquire about so-called "elixirs of longevity."
While it is always good to keep an eye on your health, I do not recommend the use of unnecessary medications.
Seeking remedies when one is not ill can easily disrupt the body's workings instead.
After much thought, I decided to write these "patients" a rather special "prescription" instead:
"Anger depresses the liver and gall, and worry burdens the spleen and stomach. Obsession gives rise to illness, while a calm mind lightens the entire body."
As for the "special ingredient," one might say it can be freely taken, and yet it is also worth a veritable fortune. It is a state of mind, one of serenity and ease and in harmony with nature.
You travel far and wide, and are bound to encounter moments that weigh on the heart and mind. I hope this prescription proves to be of some help to you as well.

Barbara.title: Spicy Food...
text: I finally got to have dinner with my family over the weekend. That doesn't happen very often, so I volunteered to make one of my favorite dishes for them! But after only a few bites, Father and my sister put down their knives and forks. They smiled at me, but I could tell they were trying their best. Maybe it was... a little too spicy?

I know everyone has different tastes, and I'd never want them to eat something they don't like. Still, I really wanted to share something I love with the people I love most, so it's hard not to feel a bit disappointed...

I wonder if there's a spicy dish that even people who aren't used to spicy food could enjoy the first time they try it... Something gentle enough for beginners, maybe? I think I'll ask some friends from other nations for advice.
If you have any suggestions, please tell me when you have time. Thank you!

Beidou.title: Finally Have the Time...
text: Hey, long time no see. How've you been? I just lined up a big deal in Nod-Krai, and now the fleet's loading up on supplies at Liyue Harbor. Nod-Krai's a long way away, so I've got to make sure the trip pays off.

Still, if you ask me, I'd take life at sea over dry land any day. It's way more my style. As for dealing with piles of complicated paperwork without nodding off... heh, that kind of patience? I figure only our Lady Tianquan could manage that.

Alright, enough business talk. It's not often we get free time like this, with everyone all in one place. Might as well enjoy it while we can and talk about our latest adventures before we all go on our separate ways again.
Oh, right. I came across these Winter Iceleas while on business not too long ago, and decided to save some for you. I hope you like it.
See you soon — I'll be waiting!

Bennett.title: A Trip to the Resort!
text: Actually, I started planning this trip as soon as I returned to Mondstadt. During this time, I took on a bunch of lucrative commissions... Even though the process was a bit bumpy, I finally managed to save up enough money! Hehe, now I can finally invite my dads and my friends from Mondstadt to the Easybreeze Holiday Resort!

I've checked and confirmed everything — the itinerary, the luggage, even the playing cards to keep my dads entertained during the trip, and the snacks I'm gonna share with my friends. You don't have to worry about anything this time, I promise! I'll make sure it's an unforgettable trip for everyone!
Benny's Adventure Team, let's go!

Candace.title: A Journey for Knowledge...
text: Several children from Aaru Village were accepted into the Akademiya a few days ago. The whole village was overjoyed. We held a grand feast for them, and the celebration went on late into the night.

The children, most of all, were too excited to rest. Even after the banquet ended, they returned to their room and kept speaking of the days to come. As they packed their bags, they wondered what they might study at the Akademiya and what they might see there... They talked like that all night long. When I went to see them in the morning, I found them sleeping soundly, scattered across their beds as only children can be.

I covered them with their blankets, and finished packing the things they had left undone. In a few days, they will depart with the caravan for the Akademiya and begin their journey in search of knowledge.
At long last, the children of Aaru Village can freely pursue the futures they desire.
To me, this may be the finest birthday gift of all.

Charlotte.title: New Lens!
text: Not too long ago, I asked Freminet to do some maintenance on Monsieur Verite, and during our chat... well, after a bit of digging on my part, I finally got some details about how you teamed up to take on the Wild Hunt!
But I guess all that prying made Freminet a little uncomfortable... my bad. So I quickly left a thank-you gift and took off, hoping I hadn't made him too uneasy.

Then, when I got back to the office, I discovered that Freminet had swapped out one of Monsieur Verite's lenses for a new one, and the image quality is amazing! I'd like you to be the first subject photographed with the new lens — would that be okay?

It's been so long since we last saw each other, and I'd really love to take a picture of you! Of course, I won't hide the fact that I'd like to interview you too... heh. If you're willing to tell me more about Nod-Krai while I'm taking your picture, that'd be even better!

Chasca.title: Bonfire Party...
text: A few days ago, a quarrel erupted between our young people and tourists from Fontaine. When I arrived, they were yelling at each other, faces flushed scarlet.

After calming everyone down, I realized that a single, innocent gesture had sparked the disagreement. The same gesture carried completely different meanings in the two places — in one, it was a friendly greeting; in the other, it was taken as a provocation.

Once the misunderstanding was cleared up, we all let out a wave of laughter. The Fontainian even remarked that I had prevented what might have turned into a full-blown "duel." People from different lands protect what they hold dear in their own ways. These days, I like to settle things with the warmth of a bonfire.
And it's that special day again — I've roasted some tender meat on hot stones and prepared chilled fruit drinks.
I've saved a place right beside me. The sky is clear, and the stars will be beautiful tonight. I hope you will join me.

Chevreuse.title: Forced to Go On Leave...
text: I have some good news and some not-so-good news: the most unmotivated members of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol have turned over a new leaf.

They used to think I was too hard on them, and would secretly grumble about the intensity of the training.
