I never would have expected that after the joint exercises with our neighboring allies, they would come to see certain gaps in their abilities and actually ask me to increase their training frequency...
This has also sparked a positive wave of competition within the team — after all, no one wants to be at the bottom.
However, the prolonged, high-intensity training and competition has left many of them burned out, and this has in turn affected their performance in missions.
So, I've sent the most exhausted among them on break, and promised to lead by example and take a breather myself.
Take today, for instance — I've decided to have a quiet day in with a new movie while "wiping out" the sins committed by fat and sugar...
Would you like to join me?
items: Sin: The Kind that Doesn't Need to be Dealt With

Chiori.title: Looking Back on Our Memories...
text: While sorting through my wardrobe, I came across a failed piece from years ago. Back then, I thought it was absolutely dreadful — but looking at it now, I actually find it rather interesting.
So, I picked up my tools, and reworked the cut and stitching on the original pattern. It's still far from perfect, yet at least it's become something I'd stop to look at in a shop window.

The stitches may be rough and uneven, but they're also the clearest kind of honesty. They've also become a testament to the time I've spent on this, from my early clumsy attempts to what it is today...

I suppose it's very much the same with people. We look back after a few years, and sometimes, we find new answers to the problems that once troubled us years ago. What about you? Have you made any similar discoveries lately? Though they say we should always look forward, slowing down for memories every now and then isn't such a bad thing, I think.

Chongyun.title: A Passing Reflection...
text: Another birthday has come around. I wonder whether it is as Xingqiu says: "Only with age does one come to know the taste of sorrow." And yet, after eating the pastries prepared this morning to celebrate my birthday, I found myself feeling somewhat at a loss.

As I grow older, I suppose the time has come for me to shoulder greater responsibility. But when I think on it again... I have yet to make any real sense of my "yang energy," and my progress in the practice of mystic arts has hardly been ideal. At the thought of all this, I must admit... I do find myself somewhat troubled. Xingqiu, however, tells me that being troubled is a good thing — that there is true meaning to be found in sorrow, and something about "fearing not the drifting clouds that obscure one's sight"... But whatever the case, I would still like to first get to the bottom of this yang energy of mine...
I recall that Madame Lan Yan's family practices a form of art that can divine good and ill fortune. Should the opportunity arise, perhaps I truly ought to ask her to perform a divination for me...
Oh, right! You should try some of these pastries as well. They are especially delicious. Um... even after they've gone cold, I promise.

Citlali.title: Didn't Drink a Single Drop of Alcohol Today...
text: I steered clear of alcohol today, so there shouldn't be any problems with what I write. Yep.
Citlalin ran off this morning, so I asked Ororon to go after her. Just as I told you before, she's still the same, just like every year on this day, anxious about the return of her Stella Fortuna.

Guess what happened next? Ororon didn't come back until noon. When I went out to find him, I discovered him crouching in the bushes near a pit he'd dug. When I asked him for an explanation, he said you told him that this is the way to capture Xbalanque's fate, so it should work for Citlalin too.
What could it possibly mean? I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.

Clorinde.title: A Land of Bitter Cold...
text: My luggage is packed. Before long, Navia and I will be leaving for Snezhnaya.

It began with the Tabletop Troupe releasing a game scenario set in a land of extreme cold. I read through it. The story was good, and seemed worth trying. I suggested we use curtains and blocks of ice to recreate the appropriate atmosphere. Navia rejected the idea.

According to her, an opportunity like this is too rare to settle for an imitation. If we want the experience to leave a truly lasting impression, then we should go there ourselves... Today, she handed me train tickets to Snezhnaya as a birthday gift. It appears I have underestimated her decisiveness once again.
We are somewhat short on players at present. Still, my traveling companion is not the sort to remain idle wherever she goes. I doubt it will take us long to make plenty of new friends.
If we happen to cross paths during the journey, we can exchange greetings. You are also welcome to join us.

Collei.title: Peaceful Days...
text: I hope this letter finds you well... Master said that's a more proper way to start a letter.
As for what's changed recently... um, I don't think much has. I still go on patrol with everyone like usual, and I'm still working hard on my studies at the Akademiya.

Oh! Actually, I can finally start keeping a diary now! That counts as a change, right? The thing is, when I sit down and try to think of something worth writing about, nothing really special comes to mind...

Sumeru has been really peaceful lately. The wind in the forest, the smell of herbs, the animals I run into along the patrol route, the parts of my books that I'm starting to understand, little by little... They're all just normal, everyday things. Nothing out of the ordinary. But they make me happy.
Sometimes, I even catch myself thinking maybe all those bad days from before were just a nightmare.
The back of my neck hasn't hurt in years now. So, um, I hope these peaceful days can keep going for a long, long time.

Cyno.title: Care for a Game?
text: Recently, I once again perused some precious historical records related to the Seven Pillars of King Deshret.
Among the God King's various pillars, the Three Kings stand out for their vastly differing temperaments. Yet, they have steadfastly remained companions to this day.

While their shared experience of imprisonment in Aaru was certainly a factor, I believe the primary reason for this is their insistence on playing cards to ease their boredom throughout their long ordeal.

As you know, this is also a principle I have long subscribed to, and not really a new discovery by any means. But the strong never miss an opportunity to grow. The wisdom shown by the Three Kings has also given me a fresh spark of inspiration — compared to card games which are rather competitive and fast-paced, perhaps chess is a more family-friendly game. And do you know why?
Because chess is simply "check"-full of cheer...
Having said that, have you thought of how to counter the "chess"-sault I'm about to launch? Come, play a round with me.

Dahlia.title: "Confessing"...
text: May Barbatos' blessing bring my greetings to you.

Cardinal Seamus has been preoccupied with family matters lately, and to lighten his load, I have taken up a portion of his duties in hearing confessions. The "confession," as I prefer to see it, is a small window through which the weight in one's heart may flow. If there's a knot in your heart that needs undoing, or a secret you can't bring yourself to share elsewhere, I'm willing to keep that window open for you. I'm willing to listen to your every confession with sincerity and undivided attention.

As for myself, I find I'd also like a kind and gentle friend to chat freely with over the clinking of glasses. I'm sure this is something the Lord Barbatos would approve of, and who knows, he might even slip in through the back door to join us.
Well then, let us meet where all the winds come together.

Dehya.title: Dual Claymores?
text: We just landed a big contract. The client's generous. Good pay, and they even stocked us up with a batch of new weapons. I went to take a look and tried a few out myself.
Not bad. Smithing these days is impressive. Light, easy to handle, smooth on the swing. And from what I hear, they're made with some pretty rare, high-grade materials.

Still, I've spent too long in the desert. If a weapon doesn't have some weight to it, it just doesn't feel right in my hands. I like something with heft. That solid pull is what I trust. Been thinking I might try dual claymores next. You know anyone who's good with that style? Don't keep them to yourself. Introduce me sometime.
Anyway, even if I didn't pick one, it wasn't a wasted trip. I asked around and stocked up on some useful forging materials for you. Here. Take them. You never know when they'll come in handy!

Diluc.title: A Gathering...
text: Angel's Share has welcomed back quite a few long-absent customers since the expeditionary force returned. Charles says that among the expedition stories being discussed, any involving you inevitably becomes the center of attention, and thanks to this, our wine sales have increased considerably this month.
I ought to thank you for this in person.
However, we're rather shorthanded at the moment due to the significant increase in alcohol consumed, and I plan to make a trip to north Mondstadt soon.
Have you been to Millhaven lately? The flowers are blooming. It is a good place to relax for the holidays if you like the scenery.
Let's go there together if you're interested.

Diona.title: Come and Get Some Cake!
text: You should know what day it is today, right? Don't you dare say you don't!

Early this morning, Margaret dropped by with a huge amount of fish, saying they are the birthday gift and the reward for doubling the shop's revenue... Ugh, I've already dumped the ceviche that had been hanging outside for days into the wine, how come it gets even more popular!

That said, I discovered a special method for pickling fish that lets me infuse the canned fish with incredible flavor. Hehe... It just so happens that the fish Margaret brought along will come in handy...
Ah! Putting that aside, I've already finished the cake, so come eat it with me!
I heard that birthday wishes are especially likely to come true, so...
I hope all the drunkards won't get to drink a single drop of alcohol in the new year!

Dori.title: A Wonderful Day
text: Today is such a wonderful day! Not only is it the birthday of yours truly, Lord Sangemah Bay, but it's also the grand opening of the Fungi Garden!
You're probably wondering how the ever-busy Lord Sangemah Bay managed to make a whole garden on top of everything else, huh?

Hehe, bet you didn't see that coming! I started planning it the moment the Sumpter Beast Park wrapped up! Tickets are half price, and I'm even throwing in free water and seating. As for looking after the fungi, I've got part-time Akademiya students on it — and their pay... well, let's just say it covers their books and meals each month, and if they budget well, they can even afford a little trip.
Speaking of having fun, why don't you come over and take a look for yourself? We're good friends, aren't we? So your ticket to the Fungi Garden is on the house today.
And as for the Sumpter Beast Park — how about a special 20% off, just for you?

Durin.title: Birthday Party!
text: Traveler. It's been a while!

Aunt Alice reminded me recently that today is the day I hatched. Humans call it a "birthday." She specially reminded me that on this day, people usually invite their friends over and hold a lively gathering. So I wrote to invite you. I hope you can come!

There's something I've been wondering about. If people celebrate it with parties, then I suppose "being born" must be something happy. But when I mentioned that to Albedo and Hat Guy, they both grew quiet... They seemed to be thinking about something. I couldn't tell what it was, but it didn't feel like happiness. Perhaps "being born" means different things to different people.
Anyway, I've prepared many dishes and sweet drinks. If today is a happy day for me, then I'd like to share that happiness with them!

Emilie.title: A Lasting Note...
text: I was halfway through blending a fragrance last night when I was urgently called away to deal with another "job." When I opened the studio this morning, I expected to have to start over. Instead, I was greeted by a wonderfully rich fragrance.
It seems that leaving the sample to rest brought out a depth I hadn't expected. Perhaps that was my first surprise of the day.

I used to think of birthdays as little more than markers in the course of an otherwise ordinary life, with nothing particularly special about them. But looking back over the past year, I found myself remembering a few moments — quiet ones, but still very clear.

Perhaps some things find their meaning in much the same way as a fragrance. They do not make themselves known at first. It is only after they have lingered for a while that they become easier to remember.

I've enclosed a few samples with this letter. I hope they can offer you a little company when you are sorting through your thoughts, or simply taking a brief moment to pause. And if you feel like it, you can always tell me what you thought of them another day.

Escoffier.title: Drinks to Go With a Meal...
text: Recently, Navia has been obsessed with coming up with special blends, and whenever we host a tea party, she always brings me the most delightful surprises. I'd get drinks like "Smetana and Rye Fermented Brew," "Cocoa-Grape Juice," and even "Explosive Quenepa Berry and Coffee Foam"... While they sound a little bizarre at first, the flavors are actually blended together quite brilliantly.
So I asked, and that's when I found out she was inspired by Miss Clorinde, who in turn learned the art of mixing drinks from you...
How wonderful! So I decided to put down my teacup and write to you right away.

Since I'm taking a few days off for my birthday, why don't you come help me come up with some new drinks to go with different meals? With your unusual creativity combined with my meticulous control over ingredients, imagine just how exquisite our special blends would be!
Now, I simply must find out!

Eula.title: A New Set of Steps...
text: I hear your travels have taken you to Snezhnaya. How have you been? I've just finished a round of training myself, so things should be much quieter for me for a while.

Some time ago, Barbara visited Natlan and exchanged ideas with the local dance enthusiasts. It seems she came back with an entirely new set of steps. Amber suggested I try reworking some of the dances I usually perform as well, just for a change of pace...
Natlan's style is a little too passionate for my taste.

Snezhnayan dance, on the other hand, seems closer in character to the Dance of Sacrifice. So I looked through what material I could find and worked out a few sections of my own. Still, I'm not entirely certain they work as intended. It would be better to see the real thing for myself.

If nothing unexpected gets in the way, I should be making a trip to Snezhnaya too. When I do, I'll be counting on you to show me the most spectacular dance performances you can find. After that, we'll find somewhere quiet, and you can help me take a closer look at these new steps.

Faruzan.title: A Tasting...
text: I have recently begun conducting research into juice extraction. Ahem! This is a project born not of gluttony, I assure you, but a rigorous study pertaining to health and wellness.
It started off as an innocent attempt to recreate a nutritional formula mentioned in an ancient text. But once I started juicing, I found it rather difficult to stop.

Sunsettia with spice, Ajilenakh nut with mint... Heh, the art of ingredient pairing is as deep as the sea itself. Then, before I knew it, I had juiced every last piece of fruit brought over by Collei...

Now the students even take a detour the moment they see me holding a cup. Hmph! Young people these days just don't know how to appreciate their elders' care! But you, on the other hand, have always known how to show proper respect to your senior!

Since it's a special day today, I have set aside for you a large bucket of "Ultimate Fruit & Veggie Boost." You have to come and help me finish... Ahem, I mean, come and have a taste of it. A nutritional boost is exactly what you need with all that adventuring you do out there. Don't make your senior here worry about you now!

Fischl.title: Signs of Impending Collapse...
text: The audacity of the abyssal shadows, daring to place their profane hands upon the Prinzessin's most loyal kin as the sacred star descends!

Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, whose obsidian wings bearing the very weight of causality itself, shows signs of impending collapse... This is naught but a blasphemous decree cast from the rotting crevices of the abyssal disciples, and it shall be met with the arrows of eternal judgment! Yet, before the final reckoning comes, we must first restore the radiant splendor of Oz's wings.

O, Traveler from another world, summon forth at once those sages well-versed in the secret arts of obsidian plume rejuvenation to my presence. Do this, and the grace and glory of the Immernachtreich shall surely pour upon thee like the shimmering starlight.

Oz's Postscript: Please do not tax yourself with worry. Mein Fräulein has recently taken interest in cooking, though she has yet to master the delicate art of seasoning. "Excessive salt intake leads to the shedding of plumage" — or so the laws of this world dictate. I have intentionally allowed my form to reflect this "reaction" in hopes of awakening Mein Fräulein's health awareness in a world as unforgiving as this. You may also wish to know that her culinary skills still require considerable refinement. As such, do not feel compelled to finish the meal should it prove too much to bear.

Flins.title: Night Fishing...
text: The young master sent over quite a few fine things recently, so I spared a little of it for bait. More than enough, I thought, to treat the fish in this stretch of water to a proper meal.

Curiously enough, they have been pecking at it with all the delicacy of well-bred ladies, as though some predator were staring at them through the water, ready to strike the instant they grew careless... There is really no need for such alarm. I have already taken from this place all the peace and quiet I could ask for. That is gift enough.

You, of course, are always welcome to come and share it with me. I would only ask that you not advertise the fact too widely. For a flame that has burned as long as mine, the passing years are little more than ash gathering on the wick. Hardly something worth making a celebration of. If anyone deserves a toast, it is those who can still stand beneath the sun and take pleasure in its warmth. Though too much sunlight rather defeats the purpose of seeking peace and quiet in the first place.

I have prepared both Fire-Water and plain water. The former should drive the cold of Snezhnaya's wind and snow from your bones. The latter should put out whatever irritation the small troubles of the road may have sparked.
Choose whichever suits your mood.

Freminet.title: From the Books I've Been Reading...
text: A little while ago, I asked Lady Marionette a few questions about mechanics. I wanted to make some improvements to Pers. At first, I could just about keep up. But when she started explaining the mechanical principles behind the theories, and working through all the math... It felt like I'd opened a book written in a language I didn't know. I... wasn't really sure what to do with any of it. Lady Marionette noticed I was having trouble. When she found out that I'd mostly learned by working with things myself and figuring them out as I went, she recommended a few books and told me to start with the most basic theory.

Compared to the fairy-tale collections I read all the time, those theory books are definitely harder to understand. But they're also a little like a strange, fascinating cave at the bottom of the sea. The more I explore, the more I want to know what's further inside. I often try things out for myself while I read. I write down what I've learned, the things I still don't understand... and, I guess, how much progress I'm making, too.
When I've finally learned enough, I hope you and Pers will both be there to see how far I've come.

Furina.title: The Stage...
text: My dear friend,
I hope this letter finds you happily enjoying the snowy scenery of Snezhnaya, or perhaps just after you've seen a wonderful performance.

I've heard that the Korolevskiy Troupe puts on some truly impressive song and dance shows. Have you had the chance to see one yet? What did you think? Which performance was your favorite? I really wish I could come to Snezhnaya and see a few for myself. Unfortunately, my schedule has been rather full lately. I've already received the script for my next film. I can't tell you too much about it yet, of course, but I can say that I like the story very much.

Sometimes I find myself wondering whether one day I might become even more accomplished as a director than I ever was on stage. Just thinking about it is exciting. I'm very happy to be doing something I truly enjoy, so I want to make the most of this time while I can.
I hope everything goes smoothly on your journey. When you have the chance, come back to Fontaine for a visit. I'll treat you to cake!

Gaming.title: Rise and Shine!
text: Hey buddy! You up yet? C'mon, rise and shine!

It's not even dawn, and Man Chai's already shoved pen and paper right in my face, nagging me to write you a letter. According to him, he really wants you to come visit. Look at him — he's so anxious about how slow I'm writing that he's been pacing circles on the desk. He even knocked over my tea just a minute ago. Judging by past experience... I give it two more minutes before my dad starts banging on the door asking if we're fighting in here again.
Man Chai can't read, so if he ever finds out I'm writing down all his embarrassing antics... then we'll really start fighting, haha. So let's just keep this between us, yeah?

I know I say I'd like you to come over for food and drinks, but honestly? The most important thing is just seeing you again. Heard you've been dealing with some big trouble, I won't be at ease until I see with my own eyes that you're alright.
Alright, that's enough mushy talk for now. You know what I mean. I'll be waiting! Now excuse me — sounds like Dad's coming...

Ganyu.title: A Chance Encounter...
text: This morning, when I stopped by the Ministry of Civil Affairs, I happened to run into Cloud Retainer at the entrance.
I thought she was going to give me some important instructions, but after pondering for a while, she instead invited me for dinner at her place, saying she'd make me some birthday noodles.

I arrived on time, only to find a noisy contraption that was constantly spewing noodles all over the room... the floor was about to be covered with noodles. While Cloud Retainer was doing her best to repair the contraption, Ms. Shenhe was trying to untangle the noodles with her spear... When Madame Ping arrived, with Yanfei, Yaoyao, and Xiangling right behind her, we all rushed in to help. After working together for quite a while, we finally managed to get the noodles off the floor and hang them on the spear.
All in all, the "hanging noodles" made with the contraption were surprisingly delicious. I've sent you some so you can try them too.

Gorou.title: Striving for Perfection...
text: The exchanges between Watatsumi and Narukami Islands grow more frequent by the day, and travelers from all corners of Teyvat are also arriving in an endless stream.

Compared to the days of old when all we had to do was to fend off the enemy, the various routine tasks that demand the army's attention today require even more focus and attention to detail. For example, our duties now include maintaining the peace of the city, assisting Her Excellency with various administrative matters, and even mediating increasingly complex trade disputes and conducting maritime patrols...

When the tide rises, the boat may float higher, but the waves also grow larger. To me, as a general, this is undoubtedly a brand-new test, and only by striving for ever-greater perfection can I set a proper example for my subordinates.
If you have some time, you are most welcome to come back to Watatsumi Island for a chat. I would like to show you around so you can see the fruits of the labor we have cultivated with everyone.
Also, the members of Swordfish II remember you fondly, and have asked me to convey their regards to you.
May all go well with you, and may you remain safe and sound.

Hu Tao.title: A Bill for a Dear Friend...
text: Had absolutely nothing to do yesterday, so what did I do? Spent the entire day sorting through bills! They were mostly tabs run up by our dear consultant over at Xinyue Kiosk, Liuli Pavilion, Baiju Guesthouse...
Honestly, this feels rather interesting. It feels like I'm a mother cleaning up after her kid.
You must know exactly what I mean, right? After all, you're raising a little Paimon of your own! Though, she strikes me as the type who demands cold, hard cash upfront.
So, to balance out the subtle difference between cash and credit — and to really lock in our bond as best friends — yours truly had a brilliant idea: I'm sending a bill your way too!
"Order placed: One cake. Destination: Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, for Director Hu's birthday bash. Cost: 1,000 Mora. Payment date: To be determined."
Hehe, well? What do you think? I opened a genuine tab right in your name! Do you feel a sudden, heavy surge of responsibility washing over you? Don't you dare skip out on the bill, now!

Iansan.title: Wanna Come Work Out?
text: "Haven't seen you around for a while. But I see that you found some time to come work out today?"
Many of my trainees tell me they can feel their scalp tighten and sweat pouring the moment they hear these words... Does that sound familiar to you?

I used to think that tough training was the only way to success, and that the results more than justified the effort. But lately I've come to realize that setting the bar too high can have a detrimental effect on the trainee's motivation, making it harder and harder for them to keep going over time.

Seems like it's time for me to tweak my approach to training. I'm planning to add some "lightweight" activities to the schedule. Even something as simple as a ten-minute walk after dinner or a few easy stretches before bed would do. Those actually count as exercise too.
Do you have any other suggestions? And since you're already here, why not come by and knock out a few sets? I can help keep an eye on your form too!

Ifa.title: This Little Fellow...
text: Cacucu gave me quite the surprise today.

Early this morning it flew off somewhere and didn't come back, not even by lunchtime. I figured it must've been out playing all morning and gotten hungry, so I was just about to head out with some food to look for it. Then I heard this rumbling getting closer and closer.
I stepped outside, and there was Cacucu, charging toward me at the head of a whole pack of Saurians. Every one of them had fruit or flowers clamped in its mouth.
Turns out they're all old patients of mine. Haha... looks like they planned the whole thing with Cacucu to give me a birthday surprise.
Seeing them this full of energy again? Yeah, that makes me really happy. Well, with guests like these, guess I'd better put together a proper lunch.

Ineffa.title: To-Do List Updated
text: Hello.
This morning, a new item was added to my to-do list: "Birthday." Priority level: "Highest."

According to Aino's note, inviting friends to gather on a meaningful occasion can significantly increase motivation for subsequent tasks. Analysis suggests this is most likely her most effective justification for increasing today's snack quota.
However, the data does support her claim. When friends visit, Aino's mood shows a measurable increase, and my emotional module has recorded a similar positive response.
Based on the above analysis, I will fully cooperate with today's celebration. "Krum-Clank 70% Sweet" is now in high-efficiency operation. Dessert production is proceeding at maximum output.
You may come by to sample the results at any time.

Jahoda.title: A Day Off...
text: Just like before, Boss Nef has given me another "rest voucher" as my birthday gift today. She promised that I could use it to take a day off whenever I want — even if I were about to be fired.

But even if she put it that way, I mean, how could I possibly just go off on a break and leave Nef to do all the work alone? Honestly, all Ashru can do is go meow-meow-meow all day, and it's not like he can run errands for Nef or help serve tea...
Besides, if something catastrophic really did happen, it'd just be safer for me to stick close to Nef anyway.

So, yeah, I'd better save this voucher with the others for now. But, uh... would you maybe want to come hang out with me? If you show up, I could use... um, one... no, let's make it two vouchers! Two days should be plenty for us to have a blast in Nod-Krai.

Jean.title: A Day Off...
text: When I arrived at the office today, Grand Master Varka was already seated behind his desk, a large stack of pending documents beside him. Out of habit, I asked whether it was another round of paperwork requiring my assistance. To my surprise, he told me he would handle it himself and then instructed me to take the day off.
I didn't quite understand his reasoning, but I followed the order...
After considering how best to use the time, I decided to return home. I intended to clean the house thoroughly, then purchase ingredients and prepare dinner for Barbara and Father...
Much to my surprise, when I opened the door, I found Father carefully working a ball of pizza dough, while Barbara was diligently chopping a rather generous bundle of mint...
I pitched in to help make a huge dinner. We all stuffed ourselves and had a wonderful time catching up.
I set aside a slice of pizza for you. I hope it is to your liking.

Kachina.title: Giving It My All!
text: Master, how's your journey going so far?
Everything's been good on our end. Mualani has been preparing for the next Dynamic Disco, and she even asked me to help come up with some new choreography.
Of course I'm honored! But... I heard she's planning to invite quite a number of new friends this time, and I worry that I'll mess things it up...
But Mualani tells me there's nothing to worry about at all.
It's just a very casual gathering, and since dance is something that everyone creates together, there's no need for me to feel so much pressure, she says.

So yeah, I won't let her encouragement go to waste. But since I'm not a professional, I'll have to really do my best here to do a good job! I've been practicing new dance moves even in my dreams. Since you're already my master in martial arts... would you be my dance teacher this time too?

Kaedehara Kazuha.title: The Blade Within...
text: Recently, I passed by a smithy. The ringing of the hammer was so clear that, for a moment, I thought I could see again the glow of the forge at my old home.

Many people think of swords only as weapons for killing, as though a blade proves its worth only when it draws blood. But over the course of my travels, I have used a sword to carve bamboo into a flute and played a few notes into the autumn air. I have also used the back of a blade to free seabirds tangled in old nets, so they could return to the open wind. To me, a blade does not always need to leave its sheath. If it can open a way for someone who has lost their path, or free someone from what binds them, then the fire that forged it and the care of the smith were not spent in vain.

A weapon has no feelings of its own. Where its edge is turned depends entirely on the heart of the one who holds it. The more mountains I cross, the more clearly I understand this. The long blade in my hand should be used to cut through the confusion of this world. As for the clear edge within my heart, I would have it protect only those I hold dear.

I have enclosed a few whetstones with this letter. If dust or rust should gather on your blade, use them to polish it clean. And if your heart should ever become clouded or uncertain, may a clear wind stay with you and sweep away the gloom from the road ahead.

Kaeya.title: Fine Wine...
text: I heard that things haven't been easy for you lately. You have my respect for getting through it all, and may the winds carry my regards.

Grand Master Varka detailed everything about your recent ordeals in his letter. As Mika read it aloud, my heart tightened more than once... and only when I learned that all had ended well did it finally settle back where it belonged.
Heh, perhaps this sounds a touch sentimental, but I'll say it anyway: even when we're not by your side, know that every member of the Knights of Favonius stands with you.
Curious what I've been up to? I suppose there's no need to keep it a mystery — I've brewed a fine bottle of wine with my own hands, and it's waiting for the day you all return in triumph.

Kamisato Ayaka.title: Rain...
text: The rain has continued for several days now, and the plants in the courtyard seem fresher and more vibrant because of it. In the early mornings, when I open the window, a few petals carrying the first hint of autumn sometimes drift in on the breeze and come to rest upon my desk. And so, this day has come around once again.
Somehow, whenever I find myself writing to you at this time of year, I feel a quiet happiness in my heart, though it also reminds me just how quickly the days have passed.

There is no urgent reason for this letter... It is simply that, lately, I seem to have been thinking of you more often than usual. I know how many responsibilities you carry, and that you are not one to stop your journey without good reason. Even so, I cannot help but worry from time to time. If I could see for myself that you are safe and well, I think my heart would be a little more at ease.
For now, I just hope the rain passes before long, so it won't be keeping you from making your way here.

Kamisato Ayato.title: Spring's First Warmth...
text: Spring has arrived, though the air still carries a lingering chill. One still finds it prudent to bring an extra layer when heading out.
Fortunately, a set of new robes has just been finished.
Wearing them lends even the usual scenery a touch of novelty.
This morning's breeze has coaxed several clusters of flowers into bloom in the courtyard. If you have the time, do come by the estate and enjoy them while they last.
We've prepared plenty of warm cloaks, so there's no need to concern yourself with the weather.
And if you happen to linger in the garden for a while, perhaps you might share some of the curious happenings you've encountered lately. I imagine it would lend the afternoon a little extra charm.
Tea and refreshments are already prepared. You would be most welcome.
What do you think about Mehrak being able to go out and get coffee for me?

That's pretty neat, isn't it? Recently, during its free time, it has gone out on occasion to wander on the streets. And after what happened, everyone is a lot closer and so they're quite friendly to Mehrak.
That is a good thing, of course. Otherwise, I'd be so worried about it running into danger.
But I never expected it to bring back fruits and vegetables this time...
Like, why on earth???

I was so worried, I decided to secretly follow it to find out. Then, to my surprise, I saw everyone asking it to bring back the things they'd meant to take to me personally — Mr. Cyrus, Ms. Katayoun, the vendors on Treasures Street...
It seems they were all just too lazy to make the trip themselves. In the end, Mehrak brought back a book, a few tomatoes, a large container of soup, and a bag of snacks.
That's really convenient...
Right? Uh... But why is it that I can't help but feel like something isn't quite right here...

Keqing.title: Share a Bite...
text: Another year, another birthday. I'd planned to do what I did last year — prepare a proper meal myself and gather with my friends to celebrate.
But as it turns out, a member of the survey team had a family emergency and had to rush home, so I took over his work to let him return without worry.
Juggling multiple tasks is nothing new to me, but it does mean I won't be making it back to Liyue Harbor on time. The ingredients I'd ordered will have to be handed off to a neighbor instead.
Still, my teammates surprised me today with what they called a "birthday cake."
A closer look revealed it was made of mashed potatoes and carrots, shaped like a cake, with a few grilled Tiger Fish stuck on top in place of candles.
A little creativity in hard times — it's not without its charm. Would you care to share a bite with me?

Kinich.title: A Day Worth Commemorating.
text: Ajaw has been anticipating this day. He even deigned to lift his royal claws to make a gift for me. To stay true to the Volcano Cake's name, he even dug up volcanic clay for the filling. Considerable effort, I must admit.

Since reciprocity was due, I have given him his reward: a mud bath to help him relax. I imagine the volcano will answer his triumphant roar with falling stones and spurts of lava... That would be a fittingly fiery celebration for him.
With all my current commissions complete, I may now allow myself a moment of calm. A glass of hand-mixed fruit juice will serve the occasion.
If you have the time, do drop by and sample it. I still recall your preferences. The sweetness level should suit you.

Kirara.title: Impressive Big Fish
text: Mm~! Thanks to everyone at Komaniya Express reminding me, I just realized that my "birthday" is coming up soon!
My boss has already approved a long vacation for me. As soon as I finish this delivery, I can go and enjoy my well-deserved rest!

That said... That customer from Nod-Krai said he was chasing after Frostfin Whales... and asked me to take the fastest ship to catch up with him to deliver this box of Kamera equipment. In fact... he's already booked a ship for me...
Mm-meow! Why do I have to make a delivery in the middle of the sea! What if I fall into the water...
No, no, for the sake of my vacation... I mean, for the sake of Komaniya Express! Wherever the customer is, the delivery will always arrive on time!
By the way, I wonder if Chiori sells clothes suitable for sea voyages... She better have some, I hope...

Klee.title: Lots and Lots of Midsy Cakes!
text: I went to play the "Answer or You're Toast" game with Prune again today! And this time, she made a toasted snack I've never seen before!
She said it comes from her hometown in... Nod... um... I don't know how to spell the rest. And the cake is called a Mid... Mid-som... Hmm. I can't remember the whole name either.
But it smelled sooo good, and it was all soft and fluffy! I loved it, and Dodoco loved it too! So I asked Prune to make lots and lots more Mid... Midsy Cakes!
I helped decorate all the cakes, and I want to share them with everybody!
Miss Cat Lady came by too. She said once she's done delivering Miss Marjorie's package, she'll take some cakes to all the other little witches.
You and Paimon wanna eat some with me too, right? Pleeeease? They're all soft and fluffy, and once you've eaten lots and lots, your tummy will get all round and squishy, just like Dodoco!

Kujou Sara.title: Change...
text: In reviewing our correspondence, I realized this is exactly my fifth letter to you.

"Five." It is a number that is neither rushed nor tedious. It is a number that is balanced and reliable. It mirrors the current state of Inazuma, where steady progress is being made in every area of life.
And I could not help but reflect on my own conduct: while strict adherence to military discipline remains my absolute duty, I may have become overly rigid in my personal interactions.
Therefore, I am attempting to make a change. For instance, I have begun using verbal praise to commend my subordinates when they meet their training objectives.
Though it initially startled them into issuing repeated self-criticisms, troop morale has noticeably improved over the past few days.

Kamaji has also suggested I should, on my days off, learn to invite my friends over rather than engrossing myself entirely in maintaining the Statues of Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, God of Thunder.
Now that I have committed to this change, I naturally thought of you first.
We have refreshments already prepared at my humble abode. There is no need for formality — just come whenever and knock on the door as an old friend would.

Kuki Shinobu.title: An Informal Invitation.
text: In previous years, the boss and the others always kept their "surprise" preparations from me. This time, though, they asked me to review the celebration plans and their request for funding in advance. They said it was because they wanted to invite you to join us.
I checked the schedule and shopping list item by item. Surprisingly, everything was reasonable and properly arranged... Maybe Ushi kept an eye on the planning?

There is still one potential problem. They left the final item on the schedule as a "surprise," and no matter what I said, they refused to show me the details. Not that I particularly want to think about what they might be planning this time... But I do know the boss and the others genuinely want to make you feel welcome. Whatever they can do, they'll do their best.
That's why I agreed to help and write this invitation. It's nothing formal, but if you have some free time, feel free to stop by.
And don't worry. Whatever happens, I'll handle it.

Lan Yan.title: Come Play with Me in the Mountains!
text: I've been wanting to liven things up this year, so I decided to invite my friends to come visit Chenyu Vale. As soon as Xiangling stepped foot in the mountains, her eyes lit up as she dragged me all over the place to look for cooking ingredients.
I plucked some melon vines along the way, but then she stared at the vines in my hand and asked, "Don't you think these vines would make a refreshing cold dish if they were thinly sliced?"
Quite taken aback, I had to quickly sidetrack her with some wild mushrooms I spotted nearby.

And now, she's unleashing her skills in the kitchen, saying she'll prepare an all-mushroom feast. Since Chongyun and Gaming can't handle spicy food, most of these dishes will be on the milder side. However, Xiangling still prepared a slightly spicy mushroom stir-fry just for me.
Come try it with me? Xiangling has promised that "it won't be too spicy."
Oh right, I also made something yummy too... and I promise it's not spicy either, hehe.
items: Delicious Trembling Strings and Rushing Reeds

Lauma.title: Birthday...
text: Every year on my birthday, quite a few little animals come to visit the Frostmoon Scions, each bringing a "gift" of their own.

This morning, when I woke up, I found a few Lakkaberries by my pillow. And while I was straightening my clothes, several little birds hopped inside, proudly telling me they'd picked the freshest flowers for me. They even made sure to mention there wasn't much dew left on the petals, so they wouldn't get my clothes wet...

I always prepare some fresh fruits and vegetables ahead of time to welcome them. But... as more and more friends show up each year, what starts as a small gathering somehow turns into quite the feast.
Thankfully, everyone seems to have a lovely time...
...Oh! I'd better hurry and put away the "gifts" those kittens brought before they frighten anyone...

Layla.title: Snacks...
text: I'm not sure why, but over the past few months, our star course calculations have been showing huge fluctuations. Everyone in the Darshan spent days running the numbers before we managed to scrape together a conclusion: the closer a star's path is to the moon, the more the data fluctuates...
Everyone's thrilled, of course. If we can figure out what's going on... well, we won't have to worry about running out of research topics anymore...
Yeah, as you can see, she's fallen asleep again.
What she observed about the moon really was unusual, but... let's leave that distant puzzle where it is for now. There's something far more important at hand — it's her birthday today.

If you have the time, come by the Darshan, and take her out for a little walk. When she's with you, that endlessly-whirring, calculation-obsessed brain of hers actually slows down a bit, and that's good for both her body and her mind.
Do come by — I've set aside some snacks for you two to share.

Linnea.title: Rewards for the Class!
text: For my birthday this year, I'm planning give a lecture to the children at Speranza. Hehe, that'd keep them from grumbling about how "they have no idea where to send their presents to" for sure!

As for Katya, she's much more of the silent type. Though she sent the children to bed early, the kitchen light was still burning into the small hours of the morning. So I sent Lumi out on a "secret spy mission," and that's when I realized Katya was busy sneaking around making a Midsommar Torte! Ha! Did she really think she could go under the radar? A kid like me who grew up at Speranza? I could totally recognize that smell even in my sleep! So I didn't hesitate to spoil the surprise, and rolled up my sleeves to bake plenty more treats alongside her.
So, any student who gets the answer right in "Linnea's Lecture" today will be rewarded with double the sweets! You and Paimon had better come with empty stomachs!

Lisa.title: Such Excitement Outside...
text: Mondstadt's been quite the buzzing little hive lately... It probably has something to do with the Grand Master's return. Even as I sit here in the library, I can hear the excitement drifting in from outside.
That said, the rules here remain just as they always have. Once you're in here, you stay quiet, and try not to disturb those who are reading and thinking.
I hear you'll be heading to Snezhnaya soon. If you'd like to learn about their history, or are looking for a book or two that might help along the way, feel free to come by and spend some time here.
And then afterward, get yourself some good rest. The library is, after all, one of the quietest places in all of Mondstadt, which makes it perfectly suited for a restful nap.

Lynette.title: I Know.
text: Lyney thinks I've no idea. But I'm familiar with the workshop and the magic props in there, including how many there are and where they're kept. That's why I see all those extra bearings and screws, along with the new scratches on the props.
But I know when something is better left unsaid, and I know how to make sure it stays that way. This is one of those times, which is why I haven't brought this up with him yet.

In the meantime, I've picked up a tongue twister to use during magic performances. It's really effective for commanding the audience's attention, and see...? Having a blank expression on my face actually really helps here.
If you want to learn how to fly through tongue twisters without tripping up, I can teach you.
You may want to have some tea first, though. Practicing tongue twisters can really dry out the throat.
When Lyney comes, we'll break out the tongue twister for him too, as his birthday gift for this year.

Lyney.title: A Grand Surprise...
text: Ah, it is that time of year again, when I must wrestle with a most troublesome question: what kind of surprise should I cook up for everyone this time?
Using my old tricks simply won't... I might be able to fool the other children, but Lynette and Freminet? Oh no. I doubt I could so much as lift a finger before they guess exactly what I'm doing...

And so, I've taken a different tack — I've been working on an entirely new magic trick in secret! A performance like this, however... calls for a partner. A friend who's clever, quick, and totally on my wavelength.
So come on over now. I promise, this will be the most incredible miracle you will experience all year!

P.S. Please keep this just between us, all right? Lynette and Freminet mustn't know about this. Here's a little something-something to help you keep the secret, something I picked out myself. I have a feeling you'll like it.

Mavuika.title: The Warmth of the Sun...
text: How's your trip to Snezhnaya so far? You haven't run into too much trouble, I hope? Has there been a lot of snow over there? I hope you and Paimon aren't freezing too much!

I've grown so used to the heat of Natlan that it's hard for me to picture what life in Snezhnaya is like, so I can't help but be curious. Haha, hope I haven't caught you off guard with all my questions.
Over here in Natlan, we've been blessed with another beautiful sunny day, though even the blazing heat of the sun is no match for everyone's passion and enthusiasm.
We plan to hold back-to-back games at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame during the day, and once the sun goes down, we'll follow the flames back to the various tribes.

If Tumaini were to make a surprise appearance, I think everyone would explode with excitement in an instant! You're always welcome to come back anytime. Just let me know when, and I'll pick you up on my flamestrider!

Mika.title: Protecting Your Gear From the Cold...
text: I heard some time ago that our esteemed Honorary Knight planned to travel across all seven nations. By now, you must be getting close to Snezhnaya, am I right?
All the Mondstadters who've been to Snezhnaya say the cold there is quite different from what we experience at Dragonspine... So please, make sure you're well prepared for that.
In prolonged dry cold, the properties of metal components can change, and your equipment may give out before you do.

Fortunately, there's a way around that: applying a thin, even coat of Flaming Essential Oil can help mitigate the effects of extreme cold on swords and other weapons, and thus prevent them from becoming brittle. Doing this with leather goods can also keep the leather supple so that they won't snap the moment you pull on them.
I hope this little tip comes in handy, especially since the gear you're using must be quite valuable, and will so need extra care and attention...
Also, the Grand Master mentioned that we have plans to send a few knights on a study visit to Snezhnaya soon, and I'm on the list.
Who knows, maybe we'll see each other again in Snezhnaya?

Mona.title: What Should I Spend My Money On...?
text: So listen, I've managed to save up quite a large sum of money without even realizing it, and I find myself with some left over even after buying the latest equipment. I've checked my accounts multiple times, and sure enough, I have enough to go on a trip!

But I'm having trouble choosing where to go. Going somewhere farther would cost more than I'd like, while somewhere close makes it hard to get that real vacation feeling... And most importantly, I have no idea where that old hag might be these days. If I happen to cross paths with her while I'm traveling, I'll be done for...

*sigh* I've had my fair share of the misery of being broke, but I never thought I'd one day get to enjoy the struggles of having money too. Life really is getting better. Or maybe... I should just save this money for now?

Mualani.title: I Wanna Sunbathe...
text: Woohoo! Summer is my absolute favorite season alright!
You know, it's been one big party around here recently, from the beaches to the open water, and even underwater!
And I'm not exaggerating when I say the People of the Springs have been throwing parties everywhere, all day long from morning till sundown!

To make sure everyone has the best time possible, I've stocked the shop with tons of new stuff. I've brought in floaters and surfboards of course, and also some new swimsuits and sunglasses! And since they were all hand-picked by me, you can be sure that they're both stylish and practical!

I was gonna pick out a few pieces for you and Paimon, but then I was like, this one's really cute, and that one's super cool... and so I just went ahead and set aside one of every style for the two of you!

Come try them on and see if they fit! Just imagine, the three of us wearing our little shark sunglasses, sipping at our cold drinks and soaking up the sun while lounging on the back of a Koholasaurus...
Uhh... if the Koholasaurus is okay with that, that is!

Nahida.title: Growing Up Together...
text: Do you have a little time? I've been thinking about a "tiny kingdom," and I'd like to tell you about it.
I found some rather special seeds. They dream of flowers and curling vines, so I thought... what if you and I made a little garden just for them?

I've already chosen the place. Once, it was held in the embrace of a dream that burned much too brightly. But in the end, that fire broke apart into specks of starlight and drifted softly down. The earth gathered them close, and their warmth became a blanket for new shoots waiting to sprout.

I've prepared everything else, too. Fresh leaves for the flower buds to sleep in, mushroom umbrellas to keep the rain off the seedlings, and a pebble path that only tiny insects are allowed to use. Even the smallest lives need a little patch of sky that belongs to them, somewhere they can slowly unfurl at their own pace.
And when you press the very first seed into the soil, maybe you'll hear it whisper: "Wish me a happy birthday today. And after that... let's grow up together."

Navia.title: My Grand Entrance!
text: Hey, hey, hey, my dear partner! Tell me: what special occasion are we celebrating today? That's right, it's none other than... a chance to gather with old friends! And since we haven't had a party here in Fleuve Cendre for a while either, tonight, I'm picking up the tab for everyone, and all food and drinks are on Spina di Rosula!

I've also thought very carefully about how your birthday star here is going to make her entrance. See, at first I was going to just do it the usual way, descending gracefully from up high with my umbrella. But Clorinde then made a really good point about how I act a little more dignified since I'm not a kid anymore.

So this is what I've decided on: I shall make my entrance slowly and grandly on Monsieur Consigliere's back. I did ask him if it was okay to do that... and since I didn't get a reply, I'm taking that as a yes.
When I make my grand entrance later, you'd better cheer loudly for me. You know, to get everyone going and everything.

Nefer.title: Restless Undercurrents...
text: The league may have been established, but somehow, business has only become busier. Not that I find it surprising. Pleasantries are only ever skin-deep. Beneath Nod-Krai's waters, the currents are still restless, and I doubt they will settle anytime soon.

Some people see chaos as a ladder. Personally, I find the end of chaos far more telling — that final, frantic scramble before anyone can reach the top. But don't let that trouble you. Where there is a finish line, the Curatorium of Secrets tends to arrive first. The only real inconvenience is that Jahoda will have to work a little harder for the time being.
Since our last incident, I've been looking into the Fatui.

Oh, and the report came with a number of Sumeru specialties. Since they are here, I may as well share them with you. Consider it a favor that costs me nothing. A day even I had nearly forgotten, and yet someone still remembered...

Neuvillette.title: There Will Come Soft Rains...
text: Another year gone in a flash, and I hope you've been well. Now that the weather is getting chilly, it's time to layer up and break out the winter blankets.
In Snezhnaya, snow will come in winter as scheduled, while here in Fontaine, it's been overcast for days, but it hasn't rained yet.

I had briefly hoped that a light winter drizzle might fall on my birthday, but as of this morning, none has appeared. I cannot help but wonder whether my younger self would have taken any pleasure in the promised rain.
In any case, it matters little, as no rain will fall today. It is my birthday, and I should allow myself a measure of cheer.
You may therefore attend the appointment without concern; there is no need to bring an umbrella.

Nicole.title: A Gift...
text: I wasn't going to write a letter at first. Writing is terribly inefficient. It's much easier to just speak directly into your head — you know what I mean, don't you? Finding you wouldn't have been difficult, either. But Mr. Nine insisted that showing up in person over something this trivial would be disrespectful of your privacy, leaving you no space of your own, and that refusing to write even a few hundred words was taking laziness a bit too far... She rarely puts things that bluntly, so I gave in.

I worked hard to save up this Mora. I had originally planned to put it in a treasure chest for you... Wait. I'll show you how to fold this letter into the shape of one instead. That way, I still get what I wanted.
What? When someone has a birthday, plenty of people celebrate with them. So naturally, when it's an angel's birthday, everyone — including the angel herself — should be happy too, shouldn't they?
Please put the gift enclosed with this letter into the treasure chest, then take it back out again! Thank you for your cooperation!

Nilou.title: A New Dance...
text: For the past few days, everyone at the Grand Bazaar has been acting mysteriously and avoiding me. I tried asking Inayah why, but she ran away, saying she had to go to dinner — even though it was only three in the afternoon! And Najia would immediately stand up and say she needed to give Swoof a bath the moment our eyes met.

All I can do is guess... Back when we prepared the Dendro Archon's birthday celebration, we kept it all a secret from her, so maybe... just maybe, everyone is planning a birthday party for me this time. Hehe, I haven't been slacking off while everyone's been busy! I've been secretly working on a new dance that I'd like to perform for everyone tonight.
If you're free, come join the birthday celebration too — I'm sure everyone will be absolutely thrilled to see you!

Ningguang.title: What Happens When It Grows Cold All Around You?
text: Of late, the winds of change have been sweeping across the world, and so many things seem to have shifted in the blink of an eye. And you, it seems, are always at the very center of that storm stirring the heavens.

I heard that you've made your way to Snezhnaya — it must be terribly cold there. With that in mind, I have an ancient Liyue saying I wish to offer you: "Only when the year grows cold do we see that the pine and cypress are the last to wither."
I believe you are precisely much like those pines and cypresses: strong and unyielding, and fully capable of weathering the blizzards and bitter cold of Snezhnaya.

Speaking of which, today is a special occasion after all, and I went to Wanmin Restaurant to have a bowl of noodles. Xiangling's culinary skills have improved yet again. When you return to Liyue someday, you should try some as well.

Noelle.title: Knight Training...
text: Today, I prepared muffins for everyone in the Knights of Favonius. I even adjusted the recipes to suit each person's tastes.

Captain Kaeya's were lightly brushed with Dandelion Wine, Klee's have a generous layer of cream on top, Master Jean's are coffee-flavored, and Grand Master Varka's, well, his are made in an extra-large size...
Since today is my birthday, I felt it was my duty, as the maid of the Knights of Favonius, to share a bit of that happiness with everyone.
I also prepared muffins for you and Paimon. If you have time, please do come to the headquarters and enjoy them with us.
...Hm? Miss Amber is knocking on the window outside. And she's carrying... quite a lot of gift boxes...?

Ororon.title: Wish Him Luck.
text: The autumn harvest kept me pretty busy, so a while back I gave Leyla an open-ended assignment. He went to Easybreeze Holiday Resort for three weeks to do some research. (At least, that's what he called it. I think he was mostly there to have fun.) When he came back, he said he'd used the principles behind our techniques to make an original interactive puzzle device, and asked me to try it with him.

...But since I'm his teacher, I thought it might be a little hasty to start interfering with his work right away. Better to let him test it on a few Iktomisaurs first. Don't worry, I'll be there the whole time. The little ones are smart, too, and they're not his students, so they don't have to worry about being polite. If they don't like something, they'll fight back.
Somewhere along the way, just like Leyla's occasional flashes of spiritual sensitivity, I seem to have developed a bit of a sense of responsibility as his elder.

Anyway, I'd like to invite you and Granny Paimon to come watch the experiment. As long as nothing goes seriously wrong, we probably won't have to do anything. We can just sit there, eat something, and watch.

Qiqi.title: I Will Remember...
text: Miss Zibai came again today. She put her hand on my forehead. For a long time.
Her hands were warm. It felt nice...
She said it would help my memory.
But... I think my memory is better because Yaoyao gave me a new notebook.
The notebook is very pretty. And very thick. It can hold many things.
Dr. Baizhu said that if you write down a wish, it might come true...
So I wrote... I hope everyone stays healthy. Because he said "health is important" many times today.
You are traveling very far away. You must stay healthy too.
So... I wrote it a few more times. For you.
I hope you stay healthy. Mm. Now I will remember.

Raiden Shogun.title: Great Fortune...
text: Today, Miko insisted that I visit the shrine and draw a fortune slip. She claimed that it has recently caught on in Inazuma to draw a fortune slip on one's birthday as a way to divine the fortunes of the year to come.

The first slip I drew bore the words "Great Fortune." Yet upon seeing Miko's knowing smile, I suspected some contrivance on her part. Thus, I drew twice more. The result remained unchanged: "Great Fortune." Miko then said,
"You are the deity who protects Inazuma. To draw 'Great Fortune' three times in succession is surely an omen that Inazuma, too, shall know peace and prosperity in the coming year."
If Miko's words hold true, then I could ask for no more auspicious sign. I have hung the fortune slips upon the Sacred Sakura, entrusting it with my wish that Inazuma remain under its protection.
The Sacred Sakura stands as stately as ever, its blossoms flourishing in abundance. Should you pass by, come join me beneath the boughs so we can enjoy the view together.

Razor.title: Together...
text: Varka has lots of free time lately.
Sneaks off to Wolvendom without the others knowing.
Competes with me. Swimming, fists, wolf howling. Win one, get a wish.
I was happy. Howled very loud. I won.
My wish: make steel claw sharper.
Lupical, come too? We eat meat together, sit by fire together, get sharper together.

Rosaria.title: Forced to Work...
text: Unfortunately, today happened to be one of the busiest workdays...
During morning prayers, Victoria told us that the Cardinal would be returning to Mondstadt soon and urged us to give it our all.

She put it in a way as if there were ever a day I hadn't given it my all... Anyway, Barbara seemed to get fired up, dragging me and Dahlia around to arrange tables and chairs, clean the Cathedral windows, and she even said she wanted to write a new hymn...
Not surprising though, considering the Cardinal is Barbara's...

Never mind, I won't get into that. I'm finally free now. If you have time, come find me at the Tavern. Let's have a drink to celebrate my birthday. Maybe Dahlia will come too. It would be great if we could all celebrate together.

Sangonomiya Kokomi.title: About the Film...
text: Recently, watching films has become trendy on Watatsumi Island as well. I've even been asked if we could film one right here.
I thought it might be a good way to introduce Watatsumi Island to the outside world, so I agreed.

Naturally, the first step is to write a script, but there doesn't seem to be anyone on the whole island who's skilled at it, so I suppose I'll have to take care of it myself. However, the books I usually read don't seem to be good references for films...

So, I intend to study other famous works, just as I used to with books on military strategy and tactical formations. Only by thoroughly understanding the script's structure can one arrange things properly in practice.
Do you like watching films? If you have time, we could study them together. Who knows? We might even come up with ideas that really resonate with people.

Sayu.title: Almost Ready to Head Out...
text: I promised the little witches that this time, I'd go visit them in Mondstadt. I heard the boat ride takes a really long time, so I was kinda worried I'd get seasick. I practiced wobbling around with my Muji-Muji Daruma so I wouldn't fall over... I think I should be okay now.
Also, I sleep really well up in trees, but it'd be terrible if I couldn't sleep on the boat. Luckily, Prune gave me a good idea in her letter. She said eating onigiri makes you sleepy.
So I made lots and lots of onigiri and packed them into a basket. If I can't sleep, I'll eat one. If I still can't sleep, I'll eat another... Maybe I'll have one now, too.
Mm... I'm already getting sleepy...
There's still a little packing left... You travel a lot, so maybe you could come check if I've forgotten anything...
*snore*...

Sethos.title: On the Right Path...
text: There have been a number of visitors here at the desert lately, with plenty of unexpected faces among them. What a shame this sudden bustle is not for some grand festival or celebration...

Still, as an old desert saying goes: "The storm brings not only the yellow sands but also seeds from afar." Challenges draw out the wise, and as the place where such wisdom converges, the Temple of Silence should no longer remain "silent."

Sometimes I'd think to myself, if the old man knew about some of the decisions I've made, he might have become so incensed that he'd give me a good thwack on the head! But considering that I sat by his grave for a long time today and came away without a scratch, I'd like to think he's at peace with it all. Or perhaps... he's just waiting for an even greater sandstorm to brew before settling the score with me for good!
Hahaha! I suppose I can't help but ponder these "growing pains" since it's my birthday. Regardless, I remain convinced that the Temple of Silence is finally on the right path. What do you think?

Shenhe.title: New Dish...
text: For reasons unknown, more customers than usual have been ordering the Black-Back Perch Stew lately. While serving the dishes, I noticed a guest from Fontaine rinse the fish briefly in plain water before eating it.
Xiangling kept glancing at the guest. The ladle in her hand moved with more force than usual. Eventually, she approached and asked whether the dish was too spicy...
She then prepared a milder version of the Black-Back Perch Stew and brought it to their table. The guest appeared satisfied. They nearly finished all of the sauce.
When the restaurant grew quiet, Xiangling asked what I would like for my birthday. I told her I wished to learn how to make the milder version of the dish.
That way, when you visit next, whether you prefer it spicy or not, I will be able to cook it for you.

Shikanoin Heizou.title: My "Accomplice"...
text: Now, this might be a little forward, but.. you've set eyes on this letter. Which means now you're my "accomplice." Case closed.

Hehe, relax. My only "crime" was wanting one perfect day without case files getting in the way, and so I decided to make a clean getaway from the Commission. If that ever-diligent general asks, she'll find my statement on the desk: "Out surveying terrain beyond the city with the Traveler. All day."
Now, for this scheme to stay perfectly airtight, I'll need a little cooperation from the famous Traveler — just enough to make sure our testimonies line up.

Fortunately, I've already taken care of the rest. The meeting place will be a breezy spot on Byakko Plain, with excellent scenery and not a hidden lookout in sight. And since every good accomplice deserves a little compensation, I've readied some delicious snacks as your "hush money."
Well? Will you come, my accomplice? But don't take too long, or they might've dragged me back to my desk by then.

Sigewinne.title: Promise Me, Alright?
text: We recently had a patient in the infirmary who completely overworked himself. During the day he pushed himself in the production zone to earn more Credit Coupons, and at night he even went to the Pankration Ring to fight in someone else's place. In the end, he exhausted himself and collapsed.

While I was treating him, he kept asking if I had any "special medicine." Do you know why? He wanted to recover as quickly as possible so he could go right back to earning more coupons! Honestly, that kind of behavior makes me a little upset. So I made him drink some very bitter medicine and ordered him to stay in the infirmary and rest for three whole days and nights.

You mustn't do something like that, okay? Not long ago, Mr. Neuvillette mentioned in his letter that you've been running around for something very important. But no matter how important it is, your health matters even more!
So promise me you'll take good care of yourself, okay? And if you're tired, you must make sure to rest, alright?

Skirk.title: The Way We Record Things...
text: The river surges forward. Its presence is felt in the lands it shapes and nourishes along both banks. Every winding path, every inch of fertile soil, bears its mark.

In moments of reflection like this, I used to strum the strings, letting the melodies serve as a record. Now, I record these thoughts in words for you, creating a different kind of record, but a record all the same.

The cosmos stretches beyond measure, and the brief meeting of our paths within it is but a speck of dust adrift among the stars. To fixate on the moment of meeting alone is to miss the vastness in which it occurs.
So, there's no need for either of us to linger. We both have our own paths, and our own purposes to fulfill.
I believe that as long as we keep moving forward, someday, our paths will cross again. And when they do, we'll see how far we've both come.

Sucrose.title: Research...
text: A little while ago, Mr. Albedo invited Mr. Durin to join the alchemy research group that Timaeus and I have been working in. At first, Mr. Durin seemed rather reserved and didn't talk much — I thought it might take some time for us to adjust to each other's pace. But once we began delving into the actual experiments, his learning speed improved remarkably.

During our experiments, everyone only speaks when necessary, and even then our exchanges are concise and to the point. Somehow, this has made our research astonishingly efficient. Thanks to everyone's combined effort, the potion's expected efficacy has improved by approximately 3.72 percent— ah, forgive me, I've been so focused on research lately that I tend to ramble.

Would you like to visit Mondstadt sometime soon? Good Hunter has just introduced some new dishes. We could enjoy a meal together and talk about... well, interesting things. I promise, no alchemical terminology this time!

Tartaglia.title: A Proper Welcome...
text: Hey, comrade!
Fine day for a little sparring, isn't it? If I wasn't so tied up with official business, I'd be right there in front of you, ready to go a few rounds. No holding back, of course.

As you know, things within the Fatui have been rather eventful lately. What's waiting for me now isn't quite as simple as finding someone and dueling them with everything I've got. Sometimes, I find myself on the proverbial battlefield even at the meeting table... It's not exactly my favorite kind of fight, but that's what makes it worth winning.

Anyway, enough about me. Your next stop is Snezhnaya, isn't it? Feeling ready for that? You've already crossed paths with most of the Harbingers by now. But as far as your Fatui acquaintances go, I was the first... wouldn't you say?
So when you set foot in Snezhnaya, naturally, the first old friend you come looking for should be me. And if anyone gives you trouble, you are more than welcome to mention my name.
I'll see to it you get a proper welcome, comrade!

Thoma.title: My New Friend!
text: As you know, it's that time of year again: my birthday. This year, I'm planning to keep things simple as usual, which means I'll be making a nice meal at home and inviting my friends over...

I've written to Mr. Kaeya as well to invite him to the birthday party. But he said it's a long way to come to Inazuma all the way from Mondstadt, and so he might not make it in time. But he did include a gift with his reply...

Speaking of journeys, since you're now in Nod-Krai, that makes you my farthest friend! I've been hearing about your adventures from my lord and lady — it sounds you're still the same as before... No, it actually sounds like you've actually become even stronger.
Anyway, I've packed some food along with this letter. Please enjoy it! Oh — hang on, I think someone's at the door... I'd better go answer it. Let's talk again later!

Tighnari.title: Here's Some for You...
text: Good things just keep happening to me lately. First, I found several healthy specimens of endangered plants in the forest; then, back at the Akademiya, I learned that my second Natlan research application had been approved as well.

When I last went to Natlan, I spoke with a girl named Varesa and mixed up a few types of fertilizer for her. This time, aside from studying the local plant ecology, I'd also like to see how those fertilizers are working in the field.
I was planning to bring Collei with me, but Cyno wants to come along too... He says he wants to use that fertilizer to help his master grow "legendary tomatoes."
And, well... since Collei's coming, he can "co-come" too. *Sigh*
Anyway, I'm sending you some mushrooms that I just picked with this letter. They smell wonderful, so give them a try.

Traveler.title: Best Wishes on Your Birthday
text: Happy Birthday, Traveler! Please find your gift attached to this message.
Thank you for all your support. May your dreams burn ever bright, lighting your path with radiant adventures.

Varesa.title: Let's Eat to Our Hearts' Content!
text: Even though Mom and Dad said I could sleep in today, I feel like the more important the day is, the more I should push myself. Now that I'm a year older, I want to give them even less to worry about.

You know, I was already in the orchard before the sun came up! I turned the soil, did the watering, and the harvesting... I did it all myself! I even wiped down the delivery crates and stacked them nice and neat.

You know what? Work really does make you feel fulfilled inside, and now it's time to fill my stomach too! I got a birthday feast from Uncle Atolli for 200 people. Come join us! Heroes like you burn tons of energy in battle, so don't hold back and eat as much as you want! And if there isn't enough food, I can always get more!
Hehe, my stomach's already growling... Maybe I should just start eating while I wait?

Venti.title: "Penned by the Wind"
text: The never-ending winds have finally carried news of you to me — that was quite the wait.
Bright and clear at times, and gusting and surging at others... It's these rising and falling of the story chapters that make the adventure worth singing of.
So, I suppose it's time I got down to business, isn't it?
I had myself a few cups of fine wine, and sure enough, inspiration struck (we'll call it "Penned by the Wind" for now...).
Am I writing poetry? Or song lyrics? Hehe, neither, actually. I mean, it is the wind that's writing it all for me.
The wind can take any form you need: a lighthearted cheer, a sigh of relief, or the fleeting moment a gentle breeze sweeps past your face...
The wind can never be held by anyone, and neither can poetry.
And you, friend, have always been free, too.

Wanderer.title: Let's Meet Up...
text: I haven't had much free time lately, and nor have I been in the mood to specifically mark a day for myself — I mean, what's the point? We all know what we really should be doing right now, and it's definitely not gathering together in celebration, acting like everything's normal and celebrating birthdays.
But Durin sees it differently. He says that making an effort to meet someone can also be considered a meaningful action, and people united together naturally convey a certain kind of strength.
I think he's trying to shift my mindset by saying that.
Let's meet up so I can give you a gift. That way, at least for one moment, two people can be happy.

Wriothesley.title: All's Well in the End
text: I've always felt that the best way to understand a new place is to see how its people find energy, and how they waste time. So, when I had business to attend to in Nod-Krai recently, I made sure to sample the local cuisine and even stopped by an underground fighting ring or two.

You won't exactly learn refined combat techniques in those no-holds-barred matches, but you can read a lot about the participants' personalities and ways of thinking from the way they strike and defend. I have to admit, I rather enjoyed the observation... and ended up staying a few days longer than planned.
In any case, my work went smoothly, and since I was away long enough, it seems the affairs of the Fortress of Meropide managed to sort themselves out in my absence — a win-win situation, I'd say.
Oh, and as for the part where I got a little carried away... let's keep that between us, shall we?

Xiangling.title: Stepping Back to Level Up!
text: Hey, hey! Come on over! I could really use a hand at Wanmin Restaurant today. I need a volunteer to test my latest invention: a spice relief drink!

Hehe, that's right — it's to help you cool off after having spicy food! You know how Wanmin's famous for its fiery dishes, right? I've been all over Liyue these past few years, looking for new ingredients to take the spice to the next level. But... maybe I went a little overboard? Some customers are starting to, uh... back away before they even take a bite.
So I figured I'd better do something about it! If we have a way to cool things off, then everyone can dive right in and enjoy every spicy dish to the max!
Guoba's right: cooking's just like adventuring, and sometimes, you've got to take one step back, so everyone can take two steps forward!
Alright, come on! The spice relief drink's already bubbling in the kettle, so go on and give it a try!

Xianyun.title: My Birthday Banquet...
text: For my birthday banquet this year, I intend to hold it at my humble abode.

I have neglected my mountain home, having spent all this time in the mortal realm. Thankfully, an old friend of mine has kindly kept the area in front of my abode "immaculate." Since he is so fond of this serene sanctuary, I naturally took this occasion to ask him to clean the inside and outside as well. Presumably, such a task will pose no difficulty for him.

Doing so also allows me to make full use of the local resources that are available to me. I shall prepare a mint-themed banquet, using the mint harvested during the Lantern Rite, to express my gratitude to this old friend of mine. Mint tea to cleanse the heart, mint cake to clear the mind, mint wine to awaken the spirit, and mint soup to nourish the lungs... That should be enough for him to savor the mint thoroughly. Hah, surely my thoughtful arrangements will be forever etched in his memory.
