As for you, you may come at any time without concern for those menial cleaning tasks. All you need do is sit back and enjoy the banquet, for any feast of mine is sure to be a spectacular affair befitting the Adepti.

Xiao.title: Of Names and Bonds...
text: A few days ago, a bird that had injured its wing landed on the inn's eaves.

Given that this place has always been so peaceful, it likely chose to take shelter here in pursuit of that very same tranquility. Though I could not approach too closely due to my karmic afflictions, I saw that its injuries were not severe, and so I offered it some food. I imagine it will recover in a few days.
Were Mountain Shaper and Cloud Retainer here, they would surely call this a rare encounter born of our affinity. And since it concerns affinity, it must have a name so fond memories may take anchor.
You have traveled through many lands and seen much of the world. When you have the time, come and give the bird a name. Once its wing has healed, we shall return it to the wild.
The bonds between all things in heaven and earth are forged through names and sustained through remembrance. Through this tiny creature, you and I will gain yet another connection.

Xilonen.title: Next Stop...
text: Ahh... Being able to head out whenever I feel like it really is nice.

By the time you read this, I'll probably already be in Liyue, picking out ores and savoring the local cuisine. I didn't expect their jewelry to come in so many styles. Every piece has some long, detailed backstory attached to it.
Whether those stories are actual history or something the shopkeepers came up with on the spot... I can't really say.
Still. If it looks good, that's what matters.

Oh, there was something else. At the harbor, I saw a guy with a rather unusual sword hanging from his waist. It caught my eye immediately... I was going to ask him about it, but he boarded a ship before I had the chance.
From what I could tell, it was heading to Inazuma... In that case, I suppose that'll be my next stop.

Xingqiu.title: At Journey's Leisure...
text: You may not know this, but my family has been putting me through quite the regimen lately. I've been traveling here and there with the merchant caravans, then accompanying my elder brother to meet business partners... When he saw how exhausted I was, he told me in private that if my heart was truly not in this, he would speak with the family on my behalf.
But then I noticed the deep lines at the corners of his eyes, and the white that had somehow crept into his hair at the temples... The words "I don't want to" simply died in my throat.
A true hero ought to stand for family and country, for justice and principle... One cannot concern oneself with personal wishes alone.
So, from here on, I'll be learning from my brother properly and helping him manage the family's affairs. Once that begins, I expect I'll be so busy I'll scarcely know which way is up.
But today, at least, I've managed to squeeze in a day off. If you have the time, why not sit with me for a while? We can have a few more cups of tea and treat it as...
Heh. A little send-off before I set off to become a true hero?

Xinyan.title: A Sudden Spark...
text: I was rehearsing over at Yilong Wharf the other day when it suddenly started pouring. The rain kept beating down on the eaves, the flagstones, and the lanterns, and after a while, it started sounding just like an improvised drumbeat. So I picked up my guitar and played along with the rhythm from the sky. Before I knew it, I was really getting into it. My fingers were practically smoking!

That gave me an idea. If the wind and rain can become part of the music, then why not heavy snow and hail too? Just what kind of melody would my rock 'n' roll fire make in a land of ice and snow? Just thinking about it has me itching to try!
...Much as I'd love to just go for it, heading to Snezhnaya isn't quite the same as making a trip to Chenyu Vale. I'll have to think it through properly first.
Anyway, I brought you some local specialties. Keep rooting for me, alright?

Yae Miko.title: Fortune Slips...
text: Recently, the shrine's fortune slips have been running low, so I was about to prepare another batch of "Great Fortune" slips.
Just as I was getting started, Ei arrived and said she wished to see me draw one for herself. Oh, my dear god...
Surely she cannot still suspect me of a little foul play, even after a full day has passed?
Fortunately, the slip I drew read "Good Fortune." A most convenient result, wouldn't you say?

I can guess what was weighing on her mind. Ei thinks far too much, and allows herself to accept far too little. When luck smiles upon you, you ought simply to be pleased and take it. Life is much easier that way, after all. That is precisely why I, her familiar, draw only "Good Fortune" and still be the happier of the two.
She was silent for quite some time, then said she wished for more tea. Very well. If there is one thing we are never short of, it is tea.
Should curiosity get the better of you, come and draw a slip yourself. I shall have tea and sweets waiting.

Yanfei.title: Someone to Watch With...
text: Now this is what I call good timing! I'm in Fontaine on business, and I just happened to arrive during the Fontinalia Festival.
You were part of the film crew last time, weren't you?

Hehe, no need to look so suspicious. I obtained that information through entirely legal and fully compliant means. I don't spend every waking hour buried in law books the size of paving stones, you know — I'm also a devoted reader of The Steambird. Besides, news about you tends to travel fast.

So, will you be involved again this year? And is there anything you can tell me about the films? Nothing confidential, of course. I'm simply interested in which ones feature anything related to the law. Once I know the screening times, I can arrange my work accordingly and enjoy them without distraction.
Better yet, perhaps you could join me.
I'll bring plenty of crisp snacks and refreshing drinks.
Good company at the movies should always come prepared, after all. Well? Shall we go?

Yaoyao.title: A Year's Plan...
text: There's a saying: "A day's plan starts in the morning, and a year's plan starts in the spring!" It means mornings and spring are both the beginning of something new, so you've gotta take them seriously and build a good foundation for what comes next.
So I was thinking... a birthday is the start of a brand-new year for me, right? Then maybe you could say... "A year's plan starts on your birthday."
That's why I decided to treat today extra seriously and train twice as hard!
But Master said not to overdo it. She told me to finish my usual training, then go rest and wait for Xiangling to cook something yummy.
Oh! Speaking of that, she's been in the kitchen for ages. Why hasn't she come out yet?
Huh? Yanfei's here too? And she's carrying such a big bag. Wait, is something moving inside it...?
Wait... I'd better go take a look. What kind of "surprise" is Xiangling preparing this time...?

Yelan.title: The "Fish" Has Taken the Bait.
text: I've recently come to Nod-Krai on business. The waves along the coast are rougher than I expected. But the "fish" here are surprisingly plump, which always attracts all sorts of "anglers."

Fishing is an elegant pastime, and there's nothing wrong with folks seeking what they need. The only thing is, there aren't many rules out here, and both live and dead bait are used by anglers. Also, the mix of long and short lines here often causes tangles once movement beneath the surface is detected. Pull too hard, and at best the line snaps and the fish escapes; in the worst case, you might even get a cut or two. But if you slip, you could even end up in the water...
I've always been a firm believer in choosing the right bait and fishing spot, staying patient, and, when the moment is right, reeling in swiftly and decisively to avoid complications.
My "fish" is about to bite — care to have a taste when the time comes?

Yoimiya.title: The Number One Alliance!
text: Hehe, guess who I ran into recently? It was Klee!
She and Sayu brought a few kids I'd never met before to Naganohara to hang out with me. According to Klee, they're all very, very impressive "Little Witches" now?
How amazing!

We spent the past few days setting off fireworks and playing games together — it was so much fun! As allies in justice, we all agreed that the "heroic big sister" and the Little Witches are absolutely the best in the world!

To commemorate the occasion, everyone gathered lots of Shiny Shells, and I made all the Little Witches some pretty hair accessories. And knowing that you and Paimon are always out adventuring, we also made a special, and also very practical, memento for you. I hope that'll bring some cheer your way.
That's right, of course we made something for you two too. And why wouldn't we? The two of you have always been a part of our Number One Alliance!

Yumemizuki Mizuki.title: Stepping Away for a While...
text: Lately, I've run into a few difficulties while continuing the development of the Yumemizuki Entertainment Group.

Most of the vacant land approved by the Kanjou Commission is located far from Hanamizaka, which means the foot traffic would be limited. But if I were to secure property within the city, I'd have to deal with resident compensation and the removal of old houses...

These complications have been giving me something of a headache. That said, don't worry about me. After all, an essential skill for any clinical psychologist is knowing how to navigate their way through a crisis.
I've spent weeks buried in contracts and paperwork.
Perhaps stepping outside for a while would help clear my mind — ease the tension a little, and make room for a new idea to find its way in.
As it happens, today is a bit of a special day.
If you're free, would you walk with me along the shallows on the western side of Narukami Island? The sunset there is quite lovely.

Yun Jin.title: Legends of the Moon...
text: Do you still remember that poem "Odes of Lang: Zibai" we discussed with the White Horse Adeptus that day? Since then, the legends of the bright moon above have lingered ever more deeply in my heart, and I wish to seize that wave of creative fervor to compose a new opera before it could fade...
Though I had already composed a draft in my mind, after poring through countless historical records and ancient texts, a different thought occurred to me.

Since the bright moon illuminates all under heaven, why not let all souls join in its creation? As the classic verse goes: "Parted by a thousand miles, we share the beauty of this graceful moonlight." No matter where we may wander, we need only look upward to know we share that very same moon. This opera... It should not be written by my hand alone.

And so, I'm writing to you now in the hopes that you might add a stroke of brilliance to this work. Even a few brief lines will do — simply share the state of your heart as you gazed upon the moon, wherever and whenever that may have been. When the day comes for this opera to take the stage, sit among the audience and listen, and you will know in an instant which act holds your story within it.
I hope to see you there when that day comes.

Zhongli.title: A Leisurely Moment at Year's End...
text: Another year is coming to a close. Lanterns light up every street in the city, and visitors bustle along. Amid all this, the sharp winter chill seems to have lost some of its bite.

A few days ago, I heard a storyteller recite a passage that went: "The officials toil through the nights without rest, while the merchants shiver awaiting the market quest. Yet I rise long after the sun is high, for nothing beats leisure beneath the sky."

Though spoken in jest, there is a certain truth to these words if you pause to consider them, for we are not made of stone, and endless toil can easily do more harm than good. At the close of the year, it is only fitting to pause and review our journey — both to savor moments of past leisure and to bring order to the mind, thereby attaining a measure of serenity.
Another line goes, "Leisure stolen from busy times is the truest leisure of all," and I couldn't agree more.
By now, I'm sure you see where I'm coming from. In such felicitous moments, what better course than to come partake in tea, and share in the quiet pleasures of the season?

Zibai.title: Our Lantern Rite Farewell Feels Near, Yet Spring Has Already Passed.
text: These past few days, I have wandered through Liyue. The journey left me with certain thoughts, and so I set them down in this letter. I hope they may find favor with your discerning eye.

I once heard that the people of Liyue Harbor did not always reside there. After the floods, they came from the Guili Assembly and settled anew, just as Chenyu Vale once did from Lang-Gan. Wishing to see it for myself, I went there. As expected, the old traces have faded from sight.

Afterward, I journeyed north, from Mingyun Village to Stone Gate. There, at a tea stall, an old man spoke with me for a while. From him, I learned that in ages earlier still, people once lived and flourished around Mt. Tianheng, Qingxu Pool, and Lingju Pass.
It seems the Liyue of today is truly a present — one formed by the mingling of many peoples, bloodlines, and histories.
The past is already past. The future remains yet to come. What you and I possess is this moment alone...

I brought back some tea snacks from my travels. Their flavor is most pleasing, and I wished to share them with you. Should a chance arise in days to come, allow me to borrow a little of your leisure, that we might go there together and take a stroll in the spring breeze.
